steps.title: Prepare Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Seed neural stem cells Cor3-1 at 1.5x10^6 in 10 cm dishes and P19 cells at 1.0x10^6 in 10 cm dishes.
steps.expected_result: Cells are seeded and reach 70%-80% confluency.

steps.title: Maintain Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Incubate cells under appropriate conditions for optimal growth.
steps.expected_result: Cells are healthy and ready for further experimentation.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells once with room temperature PBS.
steps.expected_result: Cells are washed and ready for collection.

steps.title: Collect Cells
steps.instruction: Use a cell scraper to collect cells in ice-cold PBS and transfer to a microcentrifuge tube.
steps.expected_result: Cells are collected in a tube for centrifugation.

steps.title: Centrifuge Cells
steps.instruction: Pellet cells at 130xg in a refrigerated centrifuge at 4°C for 3 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Cell pellet is formed at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Lyse Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Lyse the cell pellet with 5 volumes of ice-cold E1 buffer.
steps.expected_result: Cell lysate is prepared for further processing.

steps.title: Centrifuge Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 1,100xg at 4°C for 2 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Supernatant is collected as the cytoplasm fraction.

steps.title: Resuspend Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in the same volume of E1 buffer used previously.
steps.expected_result: Pellet is resuspended for further centrifugation.

steps.title: Centrifuge Again
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the resuspended pellet at 1,100xg at 4°C for 2 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Supernatant is discarded, and the pellet is prepared for further steps.

steps.title: Final Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 2 volumes of ice-cold E2 buffer.
steps.expected_result: Pellet is ready for the final centrifugation and fractionation.

steps.title: Prepare for Western Blot
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in ice-cold E3 buffer for protein extraction.
steps.expected_result: Pellet is ready for sonication and protein extraction.

steps.title: Sonicate Protein Sample
steps.instruction: Sonicate the sample in a water bath sonicator with ice for 5 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Proteins are sheared and ready for centrifugation.

steps.title: Centrifuge Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge all fractions at 16,000× g at 4°C for 10 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Supernatants are collected for Western blot analysis.

steps.title: Prepare for Pull Down Assay
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in ice-cold E3 (benzonase) buffer.
steps.expected_result: Pellet is ready for benzonase treatment.

steps.title: Add Benzonase
steps.instruction: Add benzonase at a 1:1,000 dilution to the resuspended pellet.
steps.expected_result: Benzonase is mixed with the sample for nucleic acid digestion.

steps.title: Rotate Sample
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a rotating platform and leave to rotate at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Sample is incubated to digest nucleic acids.

steps.title: Centrifuge for Pull Down
steps.instruction: Centrifuge all fractions at 16,000× g at 4°C for 10 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Supernatants are collected for further analysis.

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from the cells using appropriate methods.
steps.expected_result: RNA is isolated and ready for cDNA synthesis.

steps.title: Convert RNA to cDNA
steps.instruction: Convert extracted RNA to cDNA using reverse transcription.
steps.expected_result: cDNA is prepared for quantitative PCR analysis.

steps.title: Perform qRT-PCR
steps.instruction: Analyze cDNA using quantitative real-time PCR to measure gene expression.
steps.expected_result: Gene expression levels are quantified.

steps.title: Submit Ethics Application
steps.instruction: Prepare and submit the application for ethics approval to the relevant ethics board.
steps.expected_result: Ethics approval is obtained for the use of human specimens.

steps.title: Receive Ethics Approval
steps.instruction: Await and confirm receipt of ethics approval from the ethics board.
steps.expected_result: Confirmation of ethics approval is received.

steps.title: Collect Biopsy Specimens
steps.instruction: Collect postmortem biopsy specimens from COVID-19 and non-COVID-19 patients.
steps.expected_result: Biopsy specimens are collected and labeled appropriately.

steps.title: Match Control Specimens
steps.instruction: Ensure proper matching of control specimens with the COVID-19 patient biopsies.
steps.expected_result: Control specimens are matched and documented.

steps.title: Fix Biopsy Specimens
steps.instruction: Fix the collected lung biopsy specimens in 4% formaldehyde for three hours at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Biopsy specimens are fixed and ready for embedding.

steps.title: Embed Specimens in Paraffin
steps.instruction: Embed the fixed biopsies in paraffin following dehydration, clearing, and embedding steps.
steps.expected_result: Biopsy specimens are embedded in paraffin.

steps.title: Cut Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Cut 4-µm thick tissue sections using a rotary microtome and place them on Superfrost slides.
steps.expected_result: Tissue sections are prepared on slides for further processing.

steps.title: Remove Paraffin from Slides
steps.instruction: Rinse the slides in Neo Clear and progressively decrease ethanol concentration to remove paraffin.
steps.expected_result: Paraffin is removed, and slides are ready for antigen retrieval.

steps.title: Perform Antigen Retrieval
steps.instruction: Immerse slides in antigen retrieval buffer and heat in a sterilizer for the specified time.
steps.expected_result: Antigen retrieval is completed, and slides are cooled.

steps.title: Block Non-Specific Binding
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with blocking buffer to prevent non-specific binding.
steps.expected_result: Slides are blocked and ready for primary antibody staining.

steps.title: Apply Primary Antibodies
steps.instruction: Prepare and apply the primary staining mix to the tissue sections, then incubate.
steps.expected_result: Primary antibodies are bound to the target antigens in the tissue.

steps.title: Acquire Images
steps.instruction: Use fluorescence and confocal microscopy to acquire images of the stained lung sections.
steps.expected_result: Images of stained sections are captured for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze Images for NET Volume
steps.instruction: Use Imaris software to analyze the acquired images and quantify the volume of NETs.
steps.expected_result: Quantification of NET volume is completed.

steps.title: Scan Lung Sections
steps.instruction: Use the Nanozoomer system to scan entire lung sections for NET-infiltrating areas.
steps.expected_result: Lung sections are scanned and ready for further analysis.

steps.title: Perform Statistical Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the collected data statistically to determine the significance of findings.
steps.expected_result: Statistical analysis results are obtained and documented.

steps.title: Germinate Tomato Seeds
steps.instruction: Germinate tomato seeds in pots filled with 100% vermiculite under controlled light/dark cycles and temperature.
steps.expected_result: Tomato seeds successfully germinated and seedlings developed.

steps.title: Irrigate Seedlings
steps.instruction: Irrigate seedlings twice a week with distilled water for one week.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings are adequately hydrated and ready for nutrient solution application.

steps.title: Apply Nutrient Solution
steps.instruction: Irrigate seedlings twice a week for three weeks with a nutrient solution adjusted to pH 6.0.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings receive necessary nutrients for optimal growth.

steps.title: Divide Tomato Plants
steps.instruction: Divide 20 uniform tomato plants into two groups: one treated and one control group.
steps.expected_result: Two groups of tomato plants established for treatment comparison.

steps.title: Apply Initial Inhibitor Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat 21-day-old tomato plants with 2 ml of the inhibitor mix by soil drench.
steps.expected_result: Inhibitor treatment applied to the first group of plants.

steps.title: Apply Subsequent Inhibitor Treatment
steps.instruction: At 23 days old, treat plants with 4 ml of the inhibitor mix by soil drench.
steps.expected_result: Second round of inhibitor treatment successfully applied.

steps.title: Final Inhibitor Treatment
steps.instruction: At 25 and 27 days old, treat plants with 8 ml of the inhibitor mix by soil drench.
steps.expected_result: Final round of inhibitor treatment completed.

steps.title: Collect Leaf Samples
steps.instruction: 24 hours after the last treatment, collect the 3rd and 4th true leaves from treated and control plants.
steps.expected_result: Leaf samples collected and ready for storage.

steps.title: Crush Leaf Samples
steps.instruction: Crush a pool of 10 plants in liquid nitrogen for further analysis.
steps.expected_result: Plant material prepared for putrescine extraction.

steps.title: Measure Biomass
steps.instruction: Weigh dried plant tissues to determine biomass.
steps.expected_result: Biomass data collected for analysis.

steps.title: Collect Leaf Samples for H2O2 Analysis
steps.instruction: Collect leaf samples for processing to quantify H2O2 levels.
steps.expected_result: Leaf samples prepared for H2O2 quantification.

steps.title: Extract RNA from Leaf Tissues
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from collected leaf tissues for gene expression analysis.
steps.expected_result: RNA samples prepared for qRT-PCR analysis.

steps.title: Analyze Hormonal Levels
steps.instruction: Perform chromatographic analysis of hormones in plant tissues using HPLC.
steps.expected_result: Hormonal profiles obtained for further investigation.

steps.title: Statistical Analysis of Results
steps.instruction: Analyze experimental data using ANOVA to assess significance across treatments.
steps.expected_result: Statistical results generated for interpretation.

steps.title: Inoculate Bacterial Strain
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony of Salmonella cells expressing pHluorin(M153R)-FliG from an LB agar plate and inoculate it into a glass test tube with 5 mL of LB, shaking at 150 rpm at 30°C overnight.
steps.expected_result: Overnight culture of Salmonella cells is prepared.

steps.title: Transfer Culture to Fresh Medium
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL of the overnight culture to 5 mL of fresh TB and incubate at 30°C with shaking at 150 rpm until the cell density reaches an OD_600 of approximately 1.8.
steps.expected_result: Fresh culture of Salmonella cells with appropriate density is obtained.

steps.title: Centrifuge Cells
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of the culture to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge at 6,000× g for 2 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Cell pellet is collected at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Wash Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 1.0 mL of motility buffer, then centrifuge again at 6,000× g for 2 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Cells are washed and resuspended in motility buffer.

steps.title: Repeat Washing Steps
steps.instruction: Repeat the washing process (steps S4) twice to ensure thorough washing of the cells.
steps.expected_result: Cells are thoroughly washed and ready for resuspension.

steps.title: Final Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in 500 µL of fresh motility buffer.
steps.expected_result: Cells are prepared in motility buffer for further experiments.

steps.title: Prepare Tunnel Slide
steps.instruction: Make a tunnel slide by sandwiching double-sided tape between a 24×32 mm coverslip and an 18×18 mm coverslip.
steps.expected_result: Tunnel slide is prepared for cell observation.

steps.title: Add Cell Suspension to Tunnel Slide
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the cell suspension to the tunnel slide and leave for 5 minutes to allow cells to attach.
steps.expected_result: Cells are attached to the coverslip surface.

steps.title: Wash Unbound Cells
steps.instruction: Wash out unbound cells by supplying 100 µL of motility buffer and absorb the excess with filter paper.
steps.expected_result: Unbound cells are removed, leaving attached cells for imaging.

steps.title: Set Up Fluorescence Microscope
steps.instruction: Put the sample on a custom-built inverted fluorescence microscope and select a 150× objective with a 1.6x variable lens.
steps.expected_result: Microscope is set up and ready for imaging.

steps.title: Capture Fluorescence Images
steps.instruction: Switch between 410 and 470 nm excitation filters and capture images of the pHluorin(M153R)-FliG fluorescent spots using the EMCCD camera.
steps.expected_result: Fluorescence images of Salmonella cells are captured.

steps.title: Prepare for pH Measurement
steps.instruction: Resuspend SJW1368 cells carrying pYVM008 in 500 µL of motility buffer containing 20 µM gramicidin and 20 mM potassium benzoate.
steps.expected_result: Cells are prepared for in vivo calibration.

steps.title: Acquire Ratiometric Fluorescence Images
steps.instruction: Acquire ratiometric fluorescence images of the cells at external pH values of 6.0, 6.5, 7.0, or 7.5.
steps.expected_result: Ratiometric fluorescence images are obtained for pH analysis.

steps.title: Suspend Purified Proteins
steps.instruction: Suspend purified pHluorin(M153R)-FliG proteins in motility buffer with distinct pH values ranging from 5.5 to 8.5.
steps.expected_result: Protein solutions at various pH values are prepared for in vitro calibration.

steps.title: Acquire Fluorescence Images of Proteins
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the protein solution to the tunnel slide and acquire fluorescence images excited by 410 and 470 nm at each pH value.
steps.expected_result: Fluorescence images of pHluorin(M153R)-FliG proteins are captured for calibration.

steps.title: Dilute blood sample
steps.instruction: Dilute the blood sample from individual A 1:2 with RPMI 1640.
steps.expected_result: The blood sample is diluted and ready for density gradient centrifugation.

steps.title: Prepare Ficoll-Hypaque solution
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Ficoll-Hypaque solution to the diluted blood sample in a centrifuge tube.
steps.expected_result: The Ficoll-Hypaque solution is prepared for centrifugation.

steps.title: Centrifuge the sample
steps.instruction: Carefully layer the diluted blood sample on top of the Ficoll-Hypaque solution and centrifuge at 800×g for 20-30 minutes at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: PBMCs are separated into distinct layers after centrifugation.

steps.title: Collect PBMC layer
steps.instruction: Carefully absorb the lymphocyte layer into a new centrifuge tube and wash with RPMI 1640.
steps.expected_result: PBMCs are collected and washed for further processing.

steps.title: Centrifuge and wash PBMCs
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension at 580×g for 10 minutes, then aspirate the supernatant and wash the pellet with RPMI 1640.
steps.expected_result: PBMCs are washed and ready for further isolation.

steps.title: Resuspend PBMCs
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml of 0.5% BSA-PBS buffer to resuspend the PBMCs and determine the cell number.
steps.expected_result: PBMCs are resuspended and cell count is determined.

steps.title: Centrifuge and wash cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300×g for 10 minutes and aspirate the supernatant completely.
steps.expected_result: Cells are pelleted and ready for resuspension.

steps.title: Add microbeads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 80 μl of 0.5% BSA-PBS buffer per 10^7 cells and add appropriate microbeads.
steps.expected_result: Cells are mixed with microbeads for positive selection.

steps.title: Incubate cells
steps.instruction: Mix well and incubate the cells for 20 minutes in the refrigerator (2-8°C).
steps.expected_result: Microbeads are bound to the target cells.

steps.title: Seed cells in culture
steps.instruction: Seed the A-CD8+ cells and B-APCs onto 24-well plates at specified ratios and volumes, adding cytokines.
steps.expected_result: Cells are set up in culture for expansion.

steps.title: Change culture medium
steps.instruction: Change the semi-culture medium after 3 days, and mix and divide wells after 5 and 7 days.
steps.expected_result: Cells are maintained and expanded in culture.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: On day 9, harvest the cells and wash with 0.5% BSA-PBS buffer.
steps.expected_result: Cells are collected and ready for enrichment.

steps.title: Enrich CD8+ CD28- T cells
steps.instruction: Add microbeads to the resuspended cell pellet and incubate, then perform MACS separation.
steps.expected_result: CD8+ CD28- T cells are enriched from the cell population.

steps.title: Prepare CD4+ T cells
steps.instruction: Isolate CD4+ T cells from individual A and prepare B-APCs or I-APCs.
steps.expected_result: CD4+ T cells and APCs are ready for coculture.

steps.title: Coculture setup
steps.instruction: Coculture CFSE-labeled CD4+ T cells with B-APCs or I-APCs in the presence or absence of CD8+ CD28- T cells.
steps.expected_result: Coculture conditions are established for proliferation assessment.

steps.title: Assess proliferation
steps.instruction: After 7 and 11 days of coculture, harvest and analyze CD4+ T cells for CFSE dilution by flow cytometry.
steps.expected_result: Proliferation of CD4+ T cells is quantified.

steps.title: Prepare cell mixture
steps.instruction: Mix responder CD4+ T cells with APCs and in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells in PBS.
steps.expected_result: Cell mixture is ready for administration.

steps.title: Administer to mice
steps.instruction: Administer the cell mixture to NOG mice via intraperitoneal injection.
steps.expected_result: Cells are successfully injected into the mice.

steps.title: Isolate spleen cells
steps.instruction: Sacrifice the mice on day 11 post-injection and isolate the spleen to generate a single-cell suspension.
steps.expected_result: Spleen cells are prepared for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Stain the isolated cells and analyze for CD4+ T cells by flow cytometry.
steps.expected_result: Presence of human CD4+ T cells in the spleen is quantified.

steps.title: Perform immunohistochemistry
steps.instruction: Conduct immunohistochemical analysis on spleen samples to visualize human T cells.
steps.expected_result: Human T cells are visualized in the spleen tissue.

steps.title: Sow Seeds
steps.instruction: Sow common bean ‘Black Valentine’ seeds in plastic pots filled with moistened vermiculite, placing the seeds just under the surface.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are planted and ready for germination.

steps.title: Place Pots in Growth Chamber
steps.instruction: Put the pots in a tub full of tap water and place them in a growth chamber at 23°C under a 16 h light/8 h dark cycle.
steps.expected_result: Pots are in the growth chamber, ensuring optimal conditions for seedling growth.

steps.title: Water Seedlings
steps.instruction: Regularly fill the tub with tap water to maintain capillary watering for the seedlings.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings receive adequate moisture for growth.

steps.title: Grow Seedlings
steps.instruction: Allow seedlings to grow for 10-12 days until primary leaves are fully expanded.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings develop fully-expanded primary leaves.

steps.title: Prepare for Inoculation
steps.instruction: Place the plants in a dark room at 19°C and 75% relative humidity for 24 hours prior to inoculation.
steps.expected_result: Plants are acclimated and ready for inoculation.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Plasmid Mix
steps.instruction: Mix the appropriate BPMV plasmids in a microfuge tube with potassium phosphate buffer to create the DNA plasmid mix.
steps.expected_result: DNA plasmid mix is prepared for inoculation.

steps.title: Powder Leaf with Carborundum
steps.instruction: Powder the upper surface of one primary leaf per plant with carborundum.
steps.expected_result: Leaf surface is prepared for mechanical inoculation.

steps.title: Apply DNA Plasmid Mix
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, place the DNA plasmid mix on the upper leaf surface at the junction between petiole and blade.
steps.expected_result: DNA plasmid mix is applied to the leaf surface.

steps.title: Rub Leaf Surface
steps.instruction: Rub the leaf surface with a gloved finger to spread the DNA plasmid mix evenly across the leaf.
steps.expected_result: DNA plasmid mix is evenly distributed on the leaf surface.

steps.title: Rinse Leaf
steps.instruction: At 3-4 minutes after rubbing, rinse the inoculated leaf with tap water until all carborundum is removed.
steps.expected_result: Leaf is rinsed clean of carborundum.

steps.title: Place Inoculated Plants in Growth Chamber
steps.instruction: Place the inoculated plants in a greenhouse or growth chamber at 19°C under a 16 h light/8 h dark cycle.
steps.expected_result: Inoculated plants are in optimal conditions for viral infection.

steps.title: Extract Total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from the plant tissues using an appropriate RNA extraction protocol.
steps.expected_result: Total RNA is isolated from the plant samples.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from the extracted RNA using reverse transcription.
steps.expected_result: cDNA is generated for further analysis.

steps.title: Analyze Gene Expression
steps.instruction: Perform semi-quantitative RT-PCR to analyze specific gene expression levels.
steps.expected_result: Gene expression data is obtained for analysis.

steps.title: Visualize GFP Expression
steps.instruction: Use UV light to visualize GFP expression in the plant tissues.
steps.expected_result: GFP expression is observed in the tissues under UV light.

steps.title: Map R-BPMV Gene
steps.instruction: Conduct segregation analysis and use linkage mapping software to map the R-BPMV resistance gene.
steps.expected_result: R-BPMV gene is mapped successfully.

steps.title: Obtain Ethical Approval
steps.instruction: Ensure that all necessary ethical approvals are obtained for patient sample collection.
steps.expected_result: Ethical approval documentation is secured.

steps.title: Collect Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples from patients diagnosed with SARS following the approved ethical guidelines.
steps.expected_result: Blood samples are collected and labeled appropriately.

steps.title: Design Plasmids
steps.instruction: Design plasmids that include the necessary viral genes, particularly the SARS-CoV S protein.
steps.expected_result: Plasmid designs are finalized and ready for construction.

steps.title: Construct Plasmids
steps.instruction: Construct the designed plasmids using appropriate molecular biology techniques.
steps.expected_result: Plasmids containing the viral genes are successfully constructed.

steps.title: Culture QT6 Cells
steps.instruction: Culture QT6 cells in appropriate growth media until they reach the desired confluence.
steps.expected_result: QT6 cells are ready for transfection.

steps.title: Transfect QT6 Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect QT6 cells with ACE2 plasmid using a suitable transfection reagent.
steps.expected_result: QT6/ACE2 cells are successfully transfected.

steps.title: Prepare for Transfection
steps.instruction: Subculture 293T/17 cells into 6-well plates to achieve 70-90% confluence.
steps.expected_result: 293T/17 cells are prepared for transfection.

steps.title: Transfect 293T Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect 293T cells with the prepared plasmid constructs using PEI and Opti-MEM.
steps.expected_result: 293T cells are transfected with viral constructs.

steps.title: Harvest Viral Supernatant
steps.instruction: Harvest the supernatant containing viral pseudotype particles after incubation.
steps.expected_result: Viral supernatant is collected and filtered.

steps.title: Store Viral Supernatant
steps.instruction: Store the filtered viral supernatant at -80°C in aliquots.
steps.expected_result: Viral supernatant is stored properly for future use.

steps.title: Infect QT6/ACE2 Cells
steps.instruction: Infect QT6/ACE2 cells with the harvested viral vectors.
steps.expected_result: QT6/ACE2 cells are infected with viral vectors.

steps.title: Measure Infectious Units
steps.instruction: Measure the titer of infectious units using a suitable assay.
steps.expected_result: Infectious units are quantified.

steps.title: Prepare Patient Serum Samples
steps.instruction: Obtain and prepare patient serum samples for neutralization assays.
steps.expected_result: Patient serum samples are ready for testing.

steps.title: Perform Neutralization Assays
steps.instruction: Conduct neutralization assays using patient serum samples against live SARS virus.
steps.expected_result: Neutralization capacity is assessed.

steps.title: Prepare Pseudotype Virus
steps.instruction: Prepare pseudotyped MLV(SARS) virions for neutralization assays.
steps.expected_result: Pseudotype virus is ready for testing.

steps.title: Conduct Neutralization Assays
steps.instruction: Perform neutralization assays using pseudotyped MLV(SARS) virions and patient serum samples.
steps.expected_result: Neutralization titers are determined.

steps.title: Prepare Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare genomic DNA from plant samples using standard procedures or the GeneJET Plant Genomic DNA Purification Kit.
steps.expected_result: Isolated genomic DNA ready for further analysis.

steps.title: Generate Negative Control
steps.instruction: Treat genomic DNA with T4 DNA polymerase to remove terminal -overhangs, followed by precipitation and resuspension.
steps.expected_result: Negative control DNA prepared for hybridization.

steps.title: Digest DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Digest genomic DNA samples and negative controls with HindIII, followed by precipitation and resuspension.
steps.expected_result: Digested DNA samples ready for gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Perform Agarose Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Separate digested DNA using agarose gel electrophoresis and stain with ethidium bromide.
steps.expected_result: Separated DNA bands visualized on the gel.

steps.title: Visualize DNA Bands
steps.instruction: Use UV light to visualize DNA bands and capture images using the Gel Doc™ XR+ System.
steps.expected_result: Images of DNA bands acquired for analysis.

steps.title: Label Oligonucleotide Probe
steps.instruction: Label the oligonucleotide probe with γ-32P-ATP using T4 PNK and purify the probe.
steps.expected_result: Labeled oligonucleotide probe ready for hybridization.

steps.title: Prehybridize Gel
steps.instruction: Prehybridize the dried gel in hybridization buffer at 50°C with shaking.
steps.expected_result: Gel prehybridized and ready for probe hybridization.

steps.title: Hybridize Gel with Probe
steps.instruction: Add the labeled probe to the gel and hybridize overnight at 50°C with shaking.
steps.expected_result: Gel hybridized with the oligonucleotide probe.

steps.title: Wash Gel
steps.instruction: Wash the gel with wash solutions to remove unbound probe.
steps.expected_result: Washed gel ready for imaging.

steps.title: Expose Gel to Imaging Plate
steps.instruction: Wrap the gel in plastic wrap and expose it to an imaging plate at 4°C.
steps.expected_result: Gel exposed for signal detection.

steps.title: Perform Dot Blot Hybridization
steps.instruction: Measure telomere length in stn1 mutants using dot blot hybridization techniques.
steps.expected_result: Telomere length data collected for analysis.

steps.title: Generate EXO1 Mutants
steps.instruction: Create exo1 stn1 double mutants through genetic crossing.
steps.expected_result: EXO1 mutant plants generated for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze EXO1 Mutants
steps.instruction: Assess the phenotypes of exo1 stn1 double mutants for telomere dysfunction.
steps.expected_result: Data on the impact of EXO1 on telomere dysfunction collected.

steps.title: Generate Telomerase-null Mutants
steps.instruction: Create telomerase-null stn1 mutants through genetic manipulation.
steps.expected_result: Telomerase-null stn1 mutants ready for analysis.

steps.title: Assess Growth Defects
steps.instruction: Evaluate growth defects in telomerase-null stn1 mutants compared to controls.
steps.expected_result: Data on growth defects collected for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze DNA Polymerase α Mutants
steps.instruction: Characterize the phenotypes of DNA polymerase α mutants and compare them to stn1 mutants.
steps.expected_result: Phenotypic data on DNA polymerase α mutants collected.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Flow Cytometry
steps.instruction: Prepare nuclear samples from stn1 atxr5 atxr6 mutants for flow cytometry analysis.
steps.expected_result: Samples ready for DNA content measurement.

steps.title: Measure DNA Content
steps.instruction: Use flow cytometry to measure nuclear DNA content in prepared samples.
steps.expected_result: DNA content data collected for analysis.

steps.title: Sort Nuclei for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Sort nuclei from stn1 mutants for subsequent genomic DNA sequencing.
steps.expected_result: Sorted nuclei ready for sequencing.

steps.title: Perform Illumina Sequencing
steps.instruction: Conduct Illumina sequencing on sorted nuclei to analyze genomic regions affected by STN1 deficiency.
steps.expected_result: Sequencing data generated for analysis.

steps.title: Access TCGA Database

steps.title: Analyze Correlation
steps.instruction: Analyze the correlation of mRNA levels with tumor progression metrics.
steps.expected_result: Correlation data is generated for further interpretation.

steps.title: Select Cell Lines
steps.instruction: Choose three human metastatic TNBC cell lines for the experiment.

steps.title: Treat with Agonists

steps.title: Prepare siRNA
steps.instruction: Design and prepare short-interfering RNA (siRNA) targeting MCU for transfection.

steps.title: Transfect Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect the selected TNBC cell lines with MCU-targeting siRNA.
steps.expected_result: MCU expression is inhibited in the transfected cell lines.

steps.title: Assess Mitochondrial Ca2+ Uptake
steps.instruction: Evaluate the impact of MCU silencing on mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake in the transfected cells.
steps.expected_result: Data on mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake is collected for analysis.

steps.title: Create Wound
steps.instruction: Perform a wound healing assay by creating a wound in a confluent monolayer of TNBC cells.

steps.title: Monitor Cell Migration
steps.instruction: Monitor and record the migration of cells into the wound area over time.
steps.expected_result: Data on cell migration is collected for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare Spheroid Culture

steps.title: Evaluate Invasion Potential
steps.instruction: Assess the invasion potential of the formed spheroids using appropriate assays.
steps.expected_result: Data on invasion potential is collected for analysis.

steps.instruction: Inject MCU-deleted MDA-MB-231 cells into SCID mice.

steps.title: Monitor Tumor Growth

steps.title: Measure NADH and NADPH Levels

steps.title: Assess ATP Production
steps.instruction: Evaluate ATP production in MCU-silenced cells to assess metabolic impact.

steps.title: Measure ROS Levels

steps.expected_result: Data on ROS production is collected for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze HIF-1α Levels

steps.title: Worm Preparation
steps.instruction: Separate the required number of starved planarians and wash them with fresh Montjuïc salts.
steps.expected_result: Worms are clean and ready for further processing.

steps.title: Transfer Worms
steps.instruction: Transfer the washed worms to the cap of a culture dish and remove the Montjuïc salts completely.
steps.expected_result: Worms are in the culture dish without any salts.

steps.title: Add CMFB
steps.instruction: Add an appropriate volume of CMFB to cover the planarians.
steps.expected_result: Planarians are submerged in CMFB.

steps.title: Slice Worms
steps.instruction: Using a scalpel, slice the worms into small pieces and ensure no large fragments remain.
steps.expected_result: Worms are diced into small fragments.

steps.title: Dissociate Cells
steps.instruction: Add CMFB and mechanically dissociate the cells by pipetting multiple times.
steps.expected_result: Cell suspension is obtained with minimal undissociated fragments.

steps.title: Strain Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Collect the cell suspension and strain it through a 40um strainer into a fresh centrifuge tube.
steps.expected_result: Strained cell suspension is ready for centrifugation.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Resuspend
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the strained cell suspension and resuspend the pellet in 1P M+10% FBS media.
steps.expected_result: Cell pellet is resuspended and ready for staining.

steps.title: Add Staining Dyes
steps.instruction: Add Hoechst 33342 and MTG to the cell suspension and incubate under appropriate conditions.
steps.expected_result: Cells are stained and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare FACS Setup
steps.instruction: Calibrate the FACS instrument and prepare for sorting stained cells.
steps.expected_result: FACS instrument is calibrated and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Run Stained Cells
steps.instruction: Run the Hoechst 33342 and MTG stained cells through the FACS machine.
steps.expected_result: Cells are analyzed and data is collected.

steps.title: Gate Populations
steps.instruction: Set gates to exclude debris and dead cells, and identify singlet live cells.
steps.expected_result: Distinct populations of live cells are identified.

steps.title: Determine Cell Populations
steps.instruction: Gate for X1, X2, and other relevant populations based on staining.
steps.expected_result: Cell populations are categorized for further analysis.

steps.title: Prepare Verapamil Treatment
steps.instruction: Prepare a solution of Verapamil for treatment of the cell suspension.
steps.expected_result: Verapamil solution is ready for application.

steps.title: Treat Cells
steps.instruction: Add Verapamil to the cell suspension and incubate under appropriate conditions.
steps.expected_result: Cells are treated with Verapamil.

steps.title: Prepare Antibody Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the PIWI-1 antibody solution for immunostaining.
steps.expected_result: Antibody solution is ready for application.

steps.title: Immunostain Cells
steps.instruction: Apply the PIWI-1 antibody to the sorted cell populations and incubate.
steps.expected_result: Cells are stained for PIWI-1.

steps.title: Prepare RNA Samples
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA from X1-MTG Low and X1-MTG High populations.
steps.expected_result: RNA samples are prepared for sequencing.

steps.title: Conduct RNA Sequencing
steps.instruction: Perform RNA sequencing on the prepared samples.
steps.expected_result: RNA sequencing data is generated.

steps.title: Prepare for Transplantation
steps.instruction: Sort the desired cell populations for transplantation into lethally irradiated planarians.
steps.expected_result: Sorted cell populations are ready for transplantation.

steps.title: Transplant Cells
steps.instruction: Transplant the sorted cells into the prepared planarians.
steps.expected_result: Cells are successfully transplanted.

steps.title: Simultaneous Staining
steps.instruction: Stain cells with both MTG and MitoTracker Orange.
steps.expected_result: Cells are stained for mitochondrial activity assessment.

steps.title: Prepare FCCP Treatment
steps.instruction: Prepare a solution of FCCP for treatment of neoblasts.
steps.expected_result: FCCP solution is ready for application.

steps.title: Treat Neoblasts
steps.instruction: Add FCCP to the neoblasts and incubate under appropriate conditions.
steps.expected_result: Neoblasts are treated with FCCP.

steps.instruction: Incubate the isolated epididymides in HBSS on ice.
steps.expected_result: Epididymides are incubated and ready for compression.

steps.title: Fix Tissues
steps.instruction: Add 2 ml of 4% PFA to the chamber containing the samples and incubate at 4°C overnight.
steps.expected_result: Tissues are fixed and ready for blocking.

steps.title: Prepare Blocking Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 200 µl of 10% normal goat serum in PBST for blocking.

steps.title: Block Samples
steps.instruction: Add the blocking solution to the samples and incubate at 37°C for 3 hours.
steps.expected_result: Samples are blocked and ready for antibody incubation.

steps.title: Incubate with Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Add primary antibody diluted in PBST to the samples and incubate at 4°C overnight.
steps.expected_result: Samples are incubated with primary antibody.

steps.title: Mount Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer samples onto a glass base dish and remove surrounding liquids by pipetting.
steps.expected_result: Samples are mounted and ready for optical clearing.

steps.title: Perform Optical Clearing
steps.instruction: Aspirate PBS and add premixed optical clearing reagents, incubating at 37°C with gentle shaking.
steps.expected_result: Samples are optically cleared and ready for imaging.

steps.title: Prepare Culture Medium

steps.title: Culture Epididymides

steps.title: Stretch PDMS Chamber
steps.instruction: Insert the PDMS chamber into the uniaxial stretching device and stretch according to manufacturer recommendations.
steps.expected_result: PDMS chamber is stretched and ready for tissue insertion.

steps.title: Align Epididymis
steps.instruction: Transfer the isolated epididymis to the chamber and align it according to the target direction of compression.

steps.title: Extract Proteins
steps.instruction: Extract proteins from the tissues using appropriate lysis buffer.

steps.title: Analyze Imaging Data
steps.instruction: Use ImageJ to analyze the imaging data for quantification of cell division orientation and junction morphology.
steps.expected_result: Quantitative data on cell division and morphology is obtained.

steps.title: Perform Statistical Tests

steps.expected_result: Statistical analysis results are obtained.

steps.title: Thaw and Culture Mycelium
steps.instruction: Thaw a frozen stock of fungal mycelia at room temperature and spread on NGM plates with antibiotics.
steps.expected_result: Mycelium is cultured on NGM plates and spores are confirmed after 1 week.

steps.title: Dislodge Spores
steps.instruction: Using a bent sterile glass Pasteur pipette, gently rub the fungal colonies to dislodge the spores and wash them into an Eppendorf tube.
steps.expected_result: Spores are collected in the Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Prepare Infection Plates
steps.instruction: Spread the collected spores on a 9 cm NGM-AG plate and allow to dry, then prepare synchronized L4 stage worms.
steps.expected_result: Infection plates are ready and synchronized worms are prepared.

steps.title: Infect Worms
steps.instruction: Transfer L4 or young adult N2 worms onto each spore-OP50 plate and incubate for 24-30 hours.
steps.expected_result: Worms are infected with spores.

steps.title: Wash Infected Worms
steps.instruction: Wash the infected worms from each plate into a Falcon tube and centrifuge to resuspend and spread on NGMY plates.
steps.expected_result: Infected worms are distributed across NGMY plates.

steps.title: Resuspend Dead Worms
steps.instruction: Add NaCl to the plates with dead worms, rub to resuspend, and transfer the solution into NGMY liquid.
steps.expected_result: Dead worms are resuspended and cultured in NGMY liquid.

steps.title: Harvest Mycelia
steps.instruction: Pour the liquid culture through a funnel lined with Miracloth to filter the mycelia and transfer to a Falcon tube.
steps.expected_result: Mycelia are collected in the Falcon tube.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Weigh the mycelia and resuspend in lysis buffer, ensuring the volume does not exceed 30 ml.
steps.expected_result: Mycelia are resuspended in lysis buffer.

steps.title: Incubate Mycelial Solution
steps.instruction: Incubate the mycelial solution at 30°C and check for fragmentation at regular intervals.
steps.expected_result: Mycelial fragments are monitored for fragmentation.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Resuspend Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the protoplast solution, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in STC buffer.
steps.expected_result: Protoplasts are resuspended and ready for further processing.

steps.title: Prepare Protoplast Solution
steps.instruction: Add ATA to a Falcon tube, mix with plasmid DNA, and then add protoplast solution.
steps.expected_result: Protoplast solution is prepared for transformation.

steps.title: Add PEG Buffer
steps.instruction: Add PEG1700 buffer to the protoplast mixture, mix gently, and incubate.
steps.expected_result: Protoplasts are treated with PEG buffer for transformation.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Resuspend
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the protoplasts in STC buffer.
steps.expected_result: Protoplasts are resuspended and ready for plating.

steps.title: Plate Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Add the protoplast solution to a 9 cm plate and spread gently, then culture at 25°C.
steps.expected_result: Protoplasts are plated and incubated for transformation.

steps.title: Collect Spores
steps.instruction: Collect spores from infected worms and culture them in NGMY.
steps.expected_result: Spores are cultured in NGMY for RNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Use Trizol and RNeasy mini Kit to extract RNA from the cultured spores.
steps.expected_result: RNA is extracted and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Dispense siRNA SMARTpools
steps.instruction: Dispense the siRNA SMARTpools into the designated wells of a 384-well plate.
steps.expected_result: siRNA SMARTpools are accurately dispensed into the wells of the 384-well plate.

steps.title: Store siRNA plates
steps.instruction: Store the 384-well plates containing siRNA SMARTpools at -80°C.
steps.expected_result: siRNA SMARTpools are securely stored at -80°C for future use.

steps.title: Thaw siRNA plates
steps.instruction: Thaw the 384-well plates containing siRNA SMARTpools at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: siRNA SMARTpools are thawed and ready for use.

steps.title: Add transfection reagent
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate transfection reagent to each well to form transfection complexes.
steps.expected_result: Transfection complexes are formed in each well.

steps.title: Add cells to complexes
steps.instruction: Add the prepared HeLa cells to the wells containing transfection complexes.
steps.expected_result: HeLa cells are added to the transfection complexes in each well.

steps.title: Wash HeLa cells
steps.instruction: Remove media from the T75 flask and rinse the HeLa cells gently with sterile PBS.
steps.expected_result: HeLa cells are washed and ready for trypsinization.

steps.title: Trypsinize HeLa cells
steps.instruction: Add trypsin to the washed HeLa cells and incubate until cells are fully dislodged.
steps.expected_result: HeLa cells are dislodged and in suspension.

steps.title: Count cell density
steps.instruction: Count the cell density using a disposable hemocytometer.
steps.expected_result: Cell density is determined and recorded.

steps.expected_result: Virus replication is monitored and data is collected for analysis.

steps.title: Deconvolute SMARTpools

steps.title: Extract RNA from cells
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from the transfected cells using an appropriate RNA extraction method.
steps.expected_result: RNA is extracted and ready for quantification.

steps.title: Quantify mRNA levels
steps.instruction: Quantify mRNA levels using qPCR with appropriate primers.
steps.expected_result: mRNA levels are quantified and data is recorded.

steps.title: Transfect HEK293 cells
steps.instruction: Transfect HEK293 cells with hybrid proteins for validation of protein interactions.
steps.expected_result: HEK293 cells are transfected and ready for pull-down assays.

steps.title: Perform pull-down assays
steps.instruction: Conduct pull-down assays to validate protein interactions.
steps.expected_result: Protein interactions are validated through pull-down assay results.

steps.title: Select AAV Serotype
steps.instruction: Choose AAV serotype 6 for its infectivity in mouse and human ES cells.
steps.expected_result: AAV serotype 6 is selected for gene delivery.

steps.title: Confirm Vector Suitability
steps.instruction: Review literature to confirm the suitability of AAV serotype 6 for the intended application.
steps.expected_result: Confirmation of AAV serotype 6's effectiveness for gene delivery.

steps.title: Administer Hormones to Mice
steps.instruction: Administer 5 IU/mouse PMSG to B6D2F1 female mice by intraperitoneal injection.
steps.expected_result: Mice are prepared for ovulation.

steps.title: Mate Mice
steps.instruction: Forty-eight hours after PMSG, administer 5 IU/mouse hCG and mate with C57BL/6N male mice.
steps.expected_result: Mice are mated and zygotes are expected to form.

steps.title: Retrieve Zygotes
steps.instruction: Retrieve zygotes from the oviduct 14-16 hours after hCG injection.
steps.expected_result: Zygotes are collected and ready for further processing.

steps.title: Prepare Zygotes
steps.instruction: Remove cumulus cells from zygotes using 0.1% hyaluronidase-containing M2 media.
steps.expected_result: Cumulus cells are removed, and zygotes are viable.

steps.instruction: Set up microinjection apparatus and prepare viral vector solution for injection.
steps.expected_result: Microinjection setup is ready with viral vector solution.

steps.title: Microinject Viral Vectors
steps.instruction: Microinject selected viral vectors encoding EGFP into the perivitelline space of each prepared embryo.
steps.expected_result: Embryos are injected with viral vectors.

steps.title: Assess Transgene Expression
steps.instruction: Use fluorescence microscopy to assess EGFP expression in embryos at the morula/blastocyst stage.
steps.expected_result: Transgene expression is confirmed in embryos.

steps.title: Prepare Cas9-RNP Solution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute crRNA and tracrRNA, then mix and anneal them to form Cas9-RNP solution.
steps.expected_result: Cas9-RNP solution is prepared and ready for electroporation.

steps.instruction: Introduce Cas9-RNP into pronuclear-stage embryos via electroporation.
steps.expected_result: Cas9-RNP is successfully introduced into embryos.

steps.title: Infect Embryos with AAV Vector
steps.instruction: Transfer embryos into KSOM-AA medium containing AAV vector after electroporation.
steps.expected_result: Embryos are infected with AAV vectors.

steps.title: Analyze Offspring
steps.instruction: Evaluate the efficiency of knockin at the Rosa26 locus by analyzing the genotypes of offspring.
steps.expected_result: Knockin efficiency is assessed through offspring analysis.

steps.title: Breed Knockin Founders
steps.instruction: Breed knockin founders and analyze the next generation offspring for germline transmission.
steps.expected_result: Germline transmission is confirmed in the next generation.

steps.title: Perform Phenotypic Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the phenotypic outcomes of the gene editing in the offspring.
steps.expected_result: Phenotypic outcomes are documented and analyzed.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze and interpret data from experiments, focusing on transgene expression levels and knockin efficiency.
steps.expected_result: Data is analyzed and interpreted for conclusions.

steps.title: Cell Harvesting
steps.instruction: Harvest approximately 20 million cells and centrifuge into a pellet.
steps.expected_result: A cell pellet is formed after centrifugation.

steps.title: Cell Washing
steps.instruction: Aspirate culture medium and resuspend the pellet in ice-cold PBS containing protease inhibitors, then centrifuge again.
steps.expected_result: Cells are washed and ready for cross-linking.

steps.title: Cross-linking Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1% formaldehyde in PBS and incubate at room temperature with gentle rocking.
steps.expected_result: Cells are cross-linked.

steps.title: Quenching Cross-linking
steps.instruction: Add glycine to the samples to quench the cross-linking reaction and rock samples at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Cross-linking is quenched.

steps.title: Nuclei Isolation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells to collect nuclei and wash with ice-cold PBS containing protease inhibitors.
steps.expected_result: Nuclei are isolated and ready for lysis.

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei in cell lysis buffer and incubate on ice.
steps.expected_result: Cells are lysed, releasing chromatin.

steps.title: Chromatin Shearing
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in Buffer D and distribute to sonication tubes for chromatin shearing using the Bioruptor® Pico.
steps.expected_result: Chromatin is sheared into appropriate fragment sizes.

steps.title: Pre-clearing Samples
steps.instruction: Pre-clear samples with ChIP Magnetic A+G beads and rotate at 4°C.
steps.expected_result: Samples are pre-cleared to reduce background.

steps.title: Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Add IgG or specific antibody to the ChIP lysate and rotate overnight at 4°C.
steps.expected_result: Antibodies are bound to the chromatin complexes.

steps.title: Washing ChIP Samples
steps.instruction: Wash ChIP samples multiple times with ChIP Low Salt Wash buffer and TE.
steps.expected_result: Non-specific DNA fragments are removed.

steps.title: Elution of Chromatin Complexes
steps.instruction: Elute chromatin complexes from magnetic beads using freshly-prepared elution buffer.
steps.expected_result: Chromatin complexes are eluted for further analysis.

steps.title: Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Perform end repair, size selection, 3' adenylation, and adapter ligation on the eluted chromatin DNA.
steps.expected_result: DNA is prepared for sequencing with adapters ligated.

steps.title: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the library using PCR to enrich adapter-ligated products.
steps.expected_result: Library is enriched for sequencing.

steps.title: Final Cleanup of Library
steps.instruction: Perform a final cleanup and purification step to prepare the library for sequencing.
steps.expected_result: A concentrated library sample is obtained.

steps.title: Library Validation
steps.instruction: Evaluate library quality using the Agilent Bioanalyzer and quantify using the KAPA Library Quantification Kit.
steps.expected_result: Library quality and concentration are assessed.

steps.title: Antibody Binding to Dynabeads
steps.instruction: Bind 1 µg of specific antibody to 15 µl of protein G dynabeads in 200 µl of blocking buffer.
steps.expected_result: Antibodies are successfully bound to the dynabeads.

steps.title: Incubation of Antibody-Dynabead Complex
steps.instruction: Incubate the antibody-dynabead complex at 4°C for 2-3 hours.
steps.expected_result: Antibodies are properly immobilized on the dynabeads.

steps.title: Dissection of Drosophila Brains
steps.instruction: Dissect the required number of larval brains in PBS.
steps.expected_result: Larval brains are collected in PBS for further processing.

steps.title: Fixation of Drosophila Brains
steps.instruction: Wash the brains once with PBS and fix them with 1% formaldehyde in PBT for 10 minutes at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Brains are fixed to preserve chromatin structure.

steps.title: Quenching and Washing
steps.instruction: Quench the crosslink with 125 mM glycine and incubate for 5 minutes, then wash twice with PBS.
steps.expected_result: Crosslinking is quenched and brains are washed.

steps.title: Dissociation of Brain Tissue
steps.instruction: Add dissociation solution to the brain tissue and incubate for 1 hour at 30°C with constant shaking.
steps.expected_result: Brain tissue is dissociated into single cells.

steps.title: Centrifugation and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the dissociated cells at 100xg to pellet them and resuspend in PBS.
steps.expected_result: Cells are pelleted and resuspended for sorting.

steps.title: Cell Sorting
steps.instruction: Sort cells on a flow cytometer under the GFP channel, sorting 1,000 cells into 200 µl of 140 mM RIPA buffer.
steps.expected_result: Type II neural stem cells are isolated based on GFP expression.

steps.title: Harvesting K562 Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest K562 cells and resuspend them in PBS.
steps.expected_result: K562 cells are prepared for fixation.

steps.title: Fixation of K562 Cells
steps.instruction: Fix K562 cells for 10 minutes at room temperature with 1% formaldehyde in PBS.
steps.expected_result: K562 cells are fixed for downstream applications.

steps.title: Quenching and Sorting K562 Cells
steps.instruction: Quench the crosslink with 125 mM glycine, incubate for 5 minutes, and sort 100 cells into 200 µl of 140 mM RIPA buffer.
steps.expected_result: K562 cells are quenched and sorted for further analysis.

steps.title: Sonication of Cell Lysate
steps.instruction: Break the nuclei of the cells collected in RIPA for 3 cycles at low power setting in a Bioruptor sonicator.
steps.expected_result: Cell lysate is sheared into smaller fragments.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Remove the blocking buffer and add the lysate to the antibody-bound dynabeads, incubating at 4°C overnight.
steps.expected_result: Chromatin is immunoprecipitated with specific antibodies.

steps.title: Tagmentation of Beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in tagmentation buffer containing Tn5 transposase and incubate at 37°C for 40 minutes.
steps.expected_result: DNA is tagged for library preparation.

steps.title: Washing of Beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with RIPA and TE buffer as specified, ensuring to perform each wash for 3 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Beads are cleaned of excess tagmentation buffer.

steps.title: PCR Setup
steps.instruction: Set up the PCR reaction with the specified primers and reagents.
steps.expected_result: PCR reaction is prepared for amplification.

steps.title: Running PCR
steps.instruction: Run the PCR reaction in a thermal cycler according to the specified cycling parameters.
steps.expected_result: DNA is amplified for library preparation.

steps.title: qPCR Setup
steps.instruction: Set up qPCR reactions using specific primer pairs on ChIP libraries.
steps.expected_result: qPCR reactions are prepared for analysis.

steps.title: Data Processing
steps.instruction: Process sequencing data, including demultiplexing and mapping.
steps.expected_result: Sequencing data is prepared for analysis.

steps.title: Peak Calling
steps.instruction: Perform peak calling on the processed data using bioinformatics tools.
steps.expected_result: Peaks are identified in the sequencing data.

steps.instruction: Collect various Arabidopsis tissues for immunoblot analysis.
steps.expected_result: Tissue samples ready for protein extraction.

steps.expected_result: Immunoblot results indicating the presence and levels of BCM1 protein.

steps.instruction: Construct a plasmid that fuses BCM1 to yellow fluorescent protein (YFP).

steps.instruction: Obtain bcm1 mutant and BCM1-overexpressing plant samples.

steps.instruction: Analyze chlorophyll levels in bcm1 mutants and BCM1-overexpressing plants.
steps.expected_result: Data on chlorophyll biosynthesis status in the different plant lines.

steps.instruction: Conduct experiments to measure ALA synthesis in bcm1 mutants and BCM1-OX plants.
steps.expected_result: Quantitative data on ALA synthesis rates.

steps.title: Examine Gene Expression

steps.expected_result: Expression profiles of chlorophyll biosynthesis genes.

steps.title: Investigate Genetic Interactions
steps.instruction: Cross bcm1 mutants with MgCh mutants to study genetic interactions.
steps.expected_result: Data on genetic interactions affecting chlorophyll metabolism.

steps.expected_result: Yeast cells ready for screening potential protein partners.

steps.title: Analyze Chlorophyll Degradation
steps.instruction: Measure chlorophyll degradation rates in Arabidopsis lines during senescence.
steps.expected_result: Quantitative data on chlorophyll degradation rates.

steps.title: Conduct Electron Microscopy
steps.instruction: Prepare samples for electron microscopy to examine chloroplast structure.
steps.expected_result: Electron micrographs showing chloroplast integrity in different Arabidopsis lines.

steps.title: Sacrifice Mice and Prepare Hindlimbs
steps.instruction: Sacrifice the mice and prepare the hindlimbs by removing skin and pinning forelimbs.
steps.expected_result: Hindlimbs are prepared for muscle dissection.

steps.title: Isolate EDL Muscle
steps.instruction: Remove the TA muscle and isolate the EDL muscle by cutting the proximal tendon.
steps.expected_result: Isolated EDL muscle is ready for digestion.

steps.title: Digest EDL Muscle
steps.instruction: Place the isolated EDL muscle in the collagenase solution and incubate under appropriate conditions.
steps.expected_result: EDL muscle is digested into individual myofibers.

steps.title: Collect Individual Myofibers
steps.instruction: Use pipettes to dissociate and collect individual myofibers from the digestion medium.
steps.expected_result: Individual myofibers are collected for further processing.

steps.title: Prepare Muscle Extracts
steps.instruction: Process the isolated myofibers to create muscle extracts for treatment.
steps.expected_result: Muscle extracts are ready for use.

steps.title: Culture Myofibers
steps.instruction: Place isolated myofibers in a floating culture condition using DMEM.
steps.expected_result: Myofibers are cultured and maintained in viable conditions.

steps.title: Co-culture Myofibers
steps.instruction: Transfer intact myofibers into wells and prepare damaged myofibers for co-culture.
steps.expected_result: Intact and damaged myofibers are co-cultured for analysis.

steps.title: Perform Immunofluorescence Staining
steps.instruction: Transfer myofibers to tubes, fix, wash, and stain with primary and secondary antibodies.
steps.expected_result: Myofibers are stained and ready for imaging.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Collect and analyze data from immunofluorescence and in vivo experiments.
steps.expected_result: Data analysis is completed to draw conclusions.

steps.title: Prepare ethical approval documentation
steps.instruction: Compile necessary documents and information required for ethical approval.
steps.expected_result: Documentation is ready for submission to the ethics committee.

steps.title: Submit ethical approval application
steps.instruction: Submit the prepared documentation to the relevant ethics committee.
steps.expected_result: Application is submitted and awaiting review.

steps.title: Receive ethical approval
steps.instruction: Await and confirm receipt of ethical approval from the committee.
steps.expected_result: Ethical approval is obtained for the study.

steps.title: Prepare tissue samples
steps.instruction: Obtain formalin-fixed/paraffin-embedded tissue samples for micro-dissection.
steps.expected_result: Tissue samples are ready for dissection.

steps.title: Set up Zeiss/PALM Microscope
steps.instruction: Calibrate and prepare the Zeiss/PALM Microscope for laser micro-dissection.
steps.expected_result: Microscope is ready for use.

steps.title: Isolate specific cell types
steps.instruction: Use the microscope to isolate specific cell types from the prepared tissue samples.
steps.expected_result: Target cell types are successfully isolated.

steps.title: Obtain MCF7 and HB2 cell lines
steps.instruction: Acquire MCF7 and HB2 cell lines from a cell repository or laboratory.
steps.expected_result: Cell lines are obtained and ready for culture.

steps.title: Transfect cell lines
steps.instruction: Perform transfection of MCF7 and HB2 cell lines to establish stable lines expressing GFP and luciferase.
steps.expected_result: Stable transfected cell lines are established.

steps.title: Collect breast surgical samples
steps.instruction: Obtain breast surgical samples for fibroblast isolation.
steps.expected_result: Surgical samples are collected and ready for processing.

steps.title: Isolate primary fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Isolate primary fibroblasts from the collected breast surgical samples.
steps.expected_result: Primary fibroblasts are successfully isolated.

steps.title: Immortalize fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Use hTERT retroviral transduction to immortalize the isolated fibroblasts.
steps.expected_result: Immortalized fibroblast cell lines are established.

steps.title: Perform cell viability assays
steps.instruction: Conduct assays to evaluate cell viability of the cultured cells.
steps.expected_result: Cell viability data is obtained.

steps.title: Evaluate cell cycle and apoptosis
steps.instruction: Perform assays to assess cell cycle progression and apoptosis in the cell lines.
steps.expected_result: Data on cell cycle and apoptosis is collected.

steps.title: Conduct migration and invasion assays
steps.instruction: Perform assays to evaluate the migration and invasion capabilities of the cells.
steps.expected_result: Data on migration and invasion is obtained.

steps.title: Prepare samples for RNA extraction
steps.instruction: Collect FFPE tissues and cell lines for RNA extraction.
steps.expected_result: Samples are ready for RNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Use specific RNA isolation kits to extract RNA from the prepared samples.
steps.expected_result: RNA is successfully extracted and purified.

steps.title: Prepare RNA for qPCR
steps.instruction: Quantify the extracted RNA and prepare it for quantitative PCR analysis.
steps.expected_result: RNA is quantified and ready for qPCR.

steps.title: Perform quantitative PCR
steps.instruction: Conduct qPCR analyses on the prepared RNA samples to quantify gene expression levels.
steps.expected_result: Gene expression data is obtained.

steps.title: Prepare miRNA arrays
steps.instruction: Obtain and prepare human miRNA v2 arrays and associated reagents for analysis.
steps.expected_result: MiRNA arrays are ready for analysis.

steps.title: Analyze miRNA expression
steps.instruction: Perform analysis of miRNA expression using the prepared arrays.
steps.expected_result: MiRNA expression data is obtained.

steps.title: Prepare cell lysates
steps.instruction: Lyse cells to obtain cell lysates for mass spectrometry analysis.
steps.expected_result: Cell lysates are prepared and ready for analysis.

steps.title: Perform capillary liquid chromatography
steps.instruction: Separate peptides from the cell lysates using capillary liquid chromatography.
steps.expected_result: Peptides are separated and ready for tandem mass spectrometry.

steps.title: Analyze peptides by mass spectrometry
steps.instruction: Analyze the separated peptides using tandem mass spectrometry.
steps.expected_result: Mass spectrometry data is obtained.

steps.title: Input data into statistical software
steps.instruction: Enter the collected data into statistical software for analysis.
steps.expected_result: Data is entered and ready for statistical analysis.

steps.title: Perform statistical analyses
steps.instruction: Analyze the data using appropriate statistical methods to determine significance.
steps.expected_result: Statistical analysis results are obtained.

steps.title: Compile TDP43 Homologs
steps.instruction: Gather sequence data for vertebrate TDP43 homologs from relevant databases.
steps.expected_result: A comprehensive database of TDP43 homolog sequences is created.

steps.title: Analyze Sequence Diversity
steps.instruction: Perform sequence alignment and diversity analysis on the compiled TDP43 homolog sequences.
steps.expected_result: A report detailing sequence diversity and conservation patterns is generated.

steps.title: Design Mutations
steps.instruction: Identify target sites in the TDP43 CTD for mutagenesis based on desired phase property alterations.
steps.expected_result: A list of designed mutations for TDP43 CTD is prepared.

steps.title: Introduce Mutations
steps.instruction: Use appropriate mutagenesis techniques to engineer mutations in the TDP43 CTD.
steps.expected_result: Mutant TDP43 CTD constructs are generated and verified.

steps.title: Construct RRM-GFP Fusion
steps.instruction: Clone the TDP43 RRM domain into a GFP expression vector to create the RRM-GFP fusion construct.
steps.expected_result: A plasmid containing the TDP43 RRM-GFP fusion is obtained.

steps.title: Transfect Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect HEK-293T TARDBP knock-out cells with the RRM-GFP fusion construct.
steps.expected_result: Cells expressing the TDP43 RRM-GFP fusion protein are obtained.

steps.title: Set Up Live-Cell Imaging
steps.instruction: Prepare the imaging setup and ensure appropriate conditions for live-cell imaging of RRM-GFP droplets.
steps.expected_result: Imaging setup is ready for monitoring phase behavior.

steps.title: Monitor Phase Behavior
steps.instruction: Use live-cell imaging techniques to observe the phase behavior of TDP43 RRM-GFP droplets over time.
steps.expected_result: Data on phase behavior of RRM-GFP droplets is collected.

steps.title: Prepare Splicing Reporter
steps.instruction: Design and construct a splicing reporter compatible with flow cytometry to assess TDP43-mediated exon skipping.
steps.expected_result: A functional splicing reporter construct is ready for use.

steps.title: Transfect Splicing Reporter
steps.instruction: Transfect HEK-293T TARDBP knock-out cells with the splicing reporter construct.
steps.expected_result: Cells expressing the splicing reporter are obtained.

steps.title: Design RT-PCR Primers
steps.instruction: Design primers specific for splicing intermediates to be analyzed by RT-PCR.
steps.expected_result: A set of RT-PCR primers for splicing analysis is prepared.

steps.title: Perform RT-PCR
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from transfected cells and perform reverse transcription-PCR to analyze splicing intermediates.
steps.expected_result: RT-PCR products are generated for analysis.

steps.title: Purify TDP43 Variants
steps.instruction: Express and purify full-length TDP43 variants from appropriate expression systems.
steps.expected_result: Purified TDP43 variants are obtained for phase separation assays.

steps.title: Assess Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Conduct in vitro assays to evaluate the phase separation behavior of purified TDP43 variants under various conditions.
steps.expected_result: Data on phase separation behavior of TDP43 variants is collected.

steps.title: Analyze Imaging Data
steps.instruction: Process and analyze data collected from live-cell imaging experiments to assess phase behavior.
steps.expected_result: Results and conclusions regarding phase behavior are documented.

steps.title: Analyze Flow Cytometry Data
steps.instruction: Analyze flow cytometry data to evaluate TDP43-mediated splicing efficiency and compare control and experimental samples.
steps.expected_result: Results on splicing efficiency are compiled and interpreted.

steps.title: Compile Final Report
steps.instruction: Integrate findings from imaging, flow cytometry, and RT-PCR analyses into a comprehensive report.
steps.expected_result: A final report summarizing TDP43 function and phase behavior is prepared.

steps.title: Prepare Inserts
steps.instruction: Synthesize the specific nano/monobody binding domain with flanking EcoRI and NotI sites.
steps.expected_result: A synthesized insert ready for cloning.

steps.title: Digest GeneArt Vector
steps.instruction: Digest the re-suspended GeneArt vector with EcoRI and NotI.
steps.expected_result: Digested vector with released insert.

steps.title: Run Agarose Gel
steps.instruction: Run the entire digest on a 1% agarose gel and excise the released cDNA insert.
steps.expected_result: Excised insert ready for purification.

steps.title: Purify Insert
steps.instruction: Purify the digested insert using the QIAquick gel extraction kit.
steps.expected_result: Purified insert in d/dH2O.

steps.title: Digest Accepting Vectors
steps.instruction: Digest accepting vectors with EcoRI and NotI.
steps.expected_result: Digested accepting vectors ready for ligation.

steps.title: Ligate Inserts
steps.instruction: Ligate the AdPROM insert into the accepting vectors using the Rapid DNA Ligation Kit.
steps.expected_result: Ligation reaction mixture ready for transformation.

steps.title: Transform Competent Cells
steps.instruction: Add ligation reaction to competent DH5α cells and perform heat shock.
steps.expected_result: Transformed cells ready for plating.

steps.title: Select Colonies
steps.instruction: Plate transformed cells onto LB agar plates with ampicillin and incubate overnight.
steps.expected_result: Colony growth on agar plates.

steps.title: Culture HEK-293 FT Cells
steps.instruction: Culture HEK-293 FT cells in complete medium under controlled conditions.
steps.expected_result: HEK-293 FT cells at 70% confluence.

steps.title: Maintain Cell Lines
steps.instruction: Culture various human and mouse cell lines in appropriate media.
steps.expected_result: Healthy and proliferating cell lines.

steps.title: Prepare Transfection Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the transfection mix by combining plasmids and PEI in serum-free Opti-MEM.
steps.expected_result: Transfection mix ready for application.

steps.title: Transfect HEK-293 FT Cells
steps.instruction: Add the transfection mix drop-wise onto HEK-293 FT cells.
steps.expected_result: Cells exposed to transfection mix.

steps.title: Infect Target Cells
steps.instruction: Add retrovirus-containing medium to target cells for infection.
steps.expected_result: Target cells exposed to retroviruses.

steps.title: Select Infected Cells
steps.instruction: Select infected cells using appropriate antibiotics.
steps.expected_result: Surviving cells are successfully integrated with retroviruses.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with ice-cold PBS before lysis.
steps.expected_result: Cells are prepared for lysis.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Lyse cells using ice-cold lysis buffer and store extracts on ice.
steps.expected_result: Cell extracts ready for protein analysis.

steps.title: Prepare SDS-PAGE
steps.instruction: Add SDS sample buffer to cell extracts and denature proteins.
steps.expected_result: Samples ready for SDS-PAGE.

steps.title: Transfer Proteins
steps.instruction: Transfer resolved proteins onto PVDF membranes after SDS-PAGE.
steps.expected_result: Proteins are immobilized on membranes.

steps.title: Isolate RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA from cells using appropriate methods.
steps.expected_result: RNA samples ready for cDNA synthesis.

steps.title: Transfect with siRNA
steps.instruction: Transfect cells with siRNA targeting the gene of interest.
steps.expected_result: Cells are treated with siRNA for gene knockdown.

steps.title: Collect Drosophila heads
steps.instruction: Select and anesthetize Drosophila flies, then collect 100 heads in a 1.5ml tube.
steps.expected_result: A tube containing 100 Drosophila heads ready for lysis.

steps.title: Homogenize heads
steps.instruction: Add Protein-mRNA lysis buffer to the tube and manually homogenize the heads.
steps.expected_result: A homogenate of Drosophila heads in lysis buffer.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate to separate the lysate from debris.
steps.expected_result: A clear lysate in the supernatant ready for RNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Add Trizol reagent to the lysate, mix, and follow the RNA extraction protocol.
steps.expected_result: Isolated RNA from the Drosophila heads.

steps.title: Prepare GeneChip Arrays
steps.instruction: Obtain GeneChip Drosophila Genome 2.0 Arrays and prepare them for hybridization.
steps.expected_result: GeneChip Arrays ready for mRNA hybridization.

steps.title: Hybridize mRNA
steps.instruction: Apply the isolated mRNA to the prepared GeneChip Arrays according to the manufacturer's instructions.
steps.expected_result: mRNA hybridized to the GeneChip Arrays.

steps.title: Analyze microarray data
steps.instruction: Use statistical software to analyze the hybridization data from the GeneChip Arrays.
steps.expected_result: Statistical analysis results identifying significant gene expression changes.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA from RNA
steps.instruction: Retrotranscribe isolated RNA into cDNA using Superscript Vilo Master Mix.
steps.expected_result: cDNA prepared for quantitative RT-PCR.

steps.title: Perform quantitative RT-PCR
steps.instruction: Use the prepared cDNA with specific primers to perform quantitative RT-PCR.
steps.expected_result: Quantitative RT-PCR results validating expression levels.

steps.title: Administer reverse transcriptase inhibitors
steps.instruction: Treat TBPH-null flies with nucleoside and non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors.
steps.expected_result: TBPH-null flies treated with inhibitors for subsequent analysis.

steps.title: Design RNAi constructs
steps.instruction: Create RNAi constructs targeting the gypsy retrotransposon.
steps.expected_result: RNAi constructs ready for transfection into Drosophila.

steps.title: Silence gypsy expression
steps.instruction: Introduce RNAi constructs into TBPH-null Drosophila to silence gypsy expression.
steps.expected_result: Gypsy expression silenced in TBPH-null Drosophila.

steps.title: Assess synaptic growth
steps.instruction: Examine synaptic growth and muscle innervation in TBPH-null flies after gypsy silencing.
steps.expected_result: Data on synaptic growth and muscle innervation in TBPH-null flies.

steps.title: Set up GFP reporter assays
steps.instruction: Prepare GFP reporter assays to evaluate siRNA machinery efficiency in Drosophila.
steps.expected_result: GFP reporter assays set up for efficiency evaluation.

steps.title: Measure Dicer-2 expression
steps.instruction: Perform qRT-PCR to measure Dicer-2 expression levels in TBPH-null and wild-type flies.
steps.expected_result: Quantitative data on Dicer-2 expression levels.

steps.title: Cross transgenic flies
steps.instruction: Cross transgenic flies expressing Dicer-2 with TBPH-null flies.
steps.expected_result: Progeny of transgenic and TBPH-null flies for behavioral assessment.

steps.title: Treat larvae with enoxacin
steps.instruction: Administer enoxacin to TBPH-null larvae to assess locomotive capacities.
steps.expected_result: TBPH-null larvae treated with enoxacin for analysis.

steps.title: Day 1: Forced Swimming
steps.instruction: Fill a glass tank with water at 23°C and place the animal in the tank for 10 minutes.
steps.expected_result: The animal swims in the tank for the designated time.

steps.title: Return Animal to Cage
steps.instruction: Carefully return the animal to a clean and dry cage with fresh bedding.
steps.expected_result: The animal is safely back in its cage to avoid chills.

steps.title: Day 2: Restraint
