steps.title: Sterilize Equipment
steps.instruction: Sterilize scissors and the inside of the biological safety cabinet using 70% ethanol.
steps.expected_result: All equipment and surfaces are sterile and ready for use.

steps.title: Obtain Arabidopsis Plants
steps.instruction: Open a plastic tray containing Arabidopsis plants covered by sporangiophores in the biological safety cabinet.
steps.expected_result: Arabidopsis plants are accessible for harvesting.

steps.title: Harvest Plant Material
steps.instruction: Harvest the aerial parts of the Arabidopsis plants into a 50ml conical tube, filling it up to the 20 ml marker.
steps.expected_result: Aerial parts of Arabidopsis are collected without soil contamination.

steps.title: Prepare Sporangia Suspension
steps.instruction: Add 15 ml of sterile water to the conical tube and shake gently to obtain sporangia in water.
steps.expected_result: A suspension of sporangia is prepared.

steps.title: Filter Suspension
steps.instruction: Filter the obtained suspension using Miracloth.
steps.expected_result: A filtered suspension of conidiospores is obtained.

steps.title: Measure and Dilute Spore Concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of conidiospores using a hemacytometer and dilute to 5×10^4 conidiospores per ml.
steps.expected_result: Conidiospore suspension is at the desired concentration.

steps.title: Inoculate Plants
steps.instruction: Saturate Arabidopsis plants with the conidiospore suspension by spraying using an Airbrush Kit.
steps.expected_result: Arabidopsis plants are inoculated with the spore suspension.

steps.title: Maintain High Humidity
steps.instruction: Place the inoculated plants in a plastic tray with a transparent lid to maintain high humidity conditions.
steps.expected_result: Inoculated plants are sealed to maintain humidity.

steps.title: Incubate Inoculated Plants
steps.instruction: Incubate the Hpa-inoculated plants in a growth chamber at 16°C under a 10 h photoperiod.
steps.expected_result: Plants are incubated under controlled conditions until sampling.

steps.title: Harvest Inoculated Seedlings
steps.instruction: Harvest aerial parts of Hpa-inoculated seedlings in a 50ml conical tube with sterile water.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings are collected for evaluation of Hpa growth.

steps.title: Vortex and Count Conidiospores
steps.instruction: Vortex the conical tube and count the number of conidiospores using a hemacytometer.
steps.expected_result: Conidiospore count is obtained for analysis.

steps.title: Measure Fresh Weight
steps.instruction: Pat the plants dry on paper towels and measure their fresh weight.
steps.expected_result: Fresh weight of the plants is recorded.

steps.title: Assess Disease Symptoms
steps.instruction: Evaluate the number of conidiospores per ml water per gram fresh weight.
steps.expected_result: Data on Hpa growth intensity is collected.

steps.title: Prepare for Staining
steps.instruction: Harvest aerial parts of Hpa-inoculated seedlings in a 50ml conical tube and cover with trypan blue solution.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings are prepared for staining to assess HR cell death.

steps.title: Stain and Incubate
steps.instruction: Boil for 1 min, then incubate for 1 h at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings are stained for evaluation.

steps.title: Replace Staining Solution
steps.instruction: Replace trypan blue solution with chloral hydrate solution and leave overnight on a shaker.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings are prepared for final staining step.

steps.title: Count Sporangiophores
steps.instruction: Count the number of sporangiophores per cotyledon using a stereomicroscope.
steps.expected_result: Data on sporangiophore count is collected for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare Vaccination Solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the VRP-SARS-N or control VRP-GFP vaccine in an appropriate buffer.
steps.expected_result: Vaccination solution is ready for administration.

steps.title: Administer Vaccine
steps.instruction: Vaccinate BALB/c mice via intranasal or subcutaneous routes.
steps.expected_result: Mice are vaccinated and monitored for adverse reactions.

steps.title: Schedule Follow-Up Vaccinations
steps.instruction: Plan and schedule follow-up vaccinations at 6-7 week intervals.
steps.expected_result: Vaccination schedule is established for the mice.

steps.title: Challenge Mice with SARS-CoV
steps.instruction: Inoculate vaccinated mice with mouse-adapted SARS-CoV.
steps.expected_result: Mice are successfully challenged with the virus.

steps.title: Monitor Mice for Immune Response
steps.instruction: Observe and record any signs of protection or immune response in challenged mice.
steps.expected_result: Data on immune response is collected.

steps.title: Deplete Memory CD4+ T Cells
steps.instruction: Administer a depletion agent to remove memory CD4+ T cells from vaccinated mice.
steps.expected_result: Memory CD4+ T cells are depleted prior to challenge.

steps.title: Confirm Depletion
steps.instruction: Verify the depletion of memory CD4+ T cells through flow cytometry.
steps.expected_result: Successful depletion of memory CD4+ T cells is confirmed.

steps.title: Prepare Antibody Solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute specific antibodies for CD4+ T cell localization analysis.
steps.expected_result: Antibody solutions are ready for use.

steps.title: Label Cells with Antibodies
steps.instruction: Label harvested cells from the airway, parenchyma, and vasculature with the prepared antibodies.
steps.expected_result: Cells are labeled for flow cytometry analysis.

steps.title: Analyze Cell Localization
steps.instruction: Use flow cytometry to analyze the localization of N-specific CD4+ T cells.
steps.expected_result: Data on T cell localization is obtained.

steps.title: Collect Lung Samples
steps.instruction: Harvest lung tissues from vaccinated mice post-challenge.
steps.expected_result: Lung samples are collected for cytokine analysis.

steps.title: Measure Cytokine Expression
steps.instruction: Use ELISA or similar methods to measure IFN-γ expression in lung samples.
steps.expected_result: Cytokine expression data is obtained.

steps.title: Prepare for Dendritic Cell Analysis
steps.instruction: Collect samples from respiratory dendritic cells after vaccination.
steps.expected_result: Samples are ready for migration analysis.

steps.title: Assess Dendritic Cell Migration
steps.instruction: Analyze the migration of dendritic cells to mediastinal lymph nodes.
steps.expected_result: Data on dendritic cell migration is collected.

steps.title: Evaluate CD8+ T Cell Frequency
steps.instruction: Harvest lung cells and assess the frequency of CD8+ T cells post-challenge.
steps.expected_result: Data on CD8+ T cell frequency is obtained.

steps.title: Assess CD8+ T Cell Functionality
steps.instruction: Perform functional assays on CD8+ T cells to evaluate their response.
steps.expected_result: Functional data on CD8+ T cells is collected.

steps.title: Collect Samples for Cross-Reactivity Testing
steps.instruction: Harvest CD4+ T cells induced by VRP-MERS-N from vaccinated mice.
steps.expected_result: Samples are ready for cross-reactivity testing.

steps.title: Test Cross-Reactivity
steps.instruction: Challenge harvested CD4+ T cells with SARS-CoV to assess cross-reactivity.
steps.expected_result: Data on cross-reactivity of CD4+ T cells is obtained.

steps.title: Prepare NGM Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare NGM plates according to Recipe 7.
steps.expected_result: NGM plates are ready for seeding with E. coli.

steps.title: Seed NGM Plates
steps.instruction: Seed prepared NGM plates with 200-300 μl of overnight grown E. coli OP50 under sterile conditions and allow to dry.
steps.expected_result: NGM plates are seeded and dried, ready for worm transfer.

steps.title: Transfer L4 Stage Worms
steps.instruction: Using a worm picker, transfer L4 stage CA1202 worms onto the seeded NGM plates.
steps.expected_result: L4 stage worms are placed on the NGM plates for growth.

steps.title: Recover Gravid Adults
steps.instruction: Wash the plates with ddH2O to recover gravid adults into a centrifuge tube.
steps.expected_result: Gravid adults are collected in the centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Prepare Sodium Hypochlorite Solution
steps.instruction: Add ddH2O, KOH, and sodium hypochlorite solution to the tube containing the worms.
steps.expected_result: The solution is prepared for egg release from the worms.

steps.title: Incubate Worms
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a low-speed rocker for 7-9 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Worms are treated to release eggs into the solution.

steps.title: Centrifuge to Pellet Eggs
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the solution to pellet the released eggs and decant the supernatant.
steps.expected_result: Eggs are pelleted at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Resuspend and Incubate Eggs
steps.instruction: Resuspend the egg pellet in 1x M9 buffer and incubate at 20°C.
steps.expected_result: Eggs are incubated and ready for transfer to NGM plates.

steps.title: Prepare Auxin Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare NGM plates containing 1 mM or 4 mM K-NAA according to Recipe 8.
steps.expected_result: Auxin plates are ready for seeding with E. coli.

steps.title: Seed Auxin Plates
steps.instruction: Seed the auxin plates with 200-300 μl of overnight grown E. coli OP50 under sterile conditions and allow to dry.
steps.expected_result: Auxin plates are seeded and dried, ready for worm transfer.

steps.title: Recover Synchronized Worms
steps.instruction: Wash the plates with 500 μl of 1x M9 buffer to recover synchronized worms into microcentrifuge tubes.
steps.expected_result: Synchronized worms are collected in the microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Transfer Worms to Auxin Plates
steps.instruction: Evenly dispense the contents of the tubes onto 2-3 NGM plates containing K-NAA seeded with E. coli OP50.
steps.expected_result: Worms are transferred to auxin plates for treatment.

steps.title: Prepare for Imaging
steps.instruction: Place the microscope slide on the stage and secure it with stage clips.
steps.expected_result: Microscope slide is ready for imaging.

steps.title: Focus on Worm
steps.instruction: Use the coarse and fine focus knobs to focus on the worm.
steps.expected_result: Worm is clearly focused for imaging.

steps.title: Capture Images
steps.instruction: Collect 16-bit z-stack images using an EM-CCD camera attached to a spinning disk confocal microscope.
steps.expected_result: Images of the worm are captured for analysis.

steps.title: Design gRNAs
steps.instruction: Identify PAM sequences and select protospacers for target genes.
steps.expected_result: gRNAs designed for target genes.

steps.title: Order Oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Order complementary single-stranded synthetic oligonucleotides for gRNAs.
steps.expected_result: Oligonucleotides received for cloning.

steps.title: Clone gRNAs into pCRISPR-SacB
steps.instruction: Phosphorylate, anneal, and ligate gRNA oligonucleotides into the pCRISPR-SacB plasmid.
steps.expected_result: pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmid constructed.

steps.title: Prepare Competent Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare electrocompetent E. coli BL21(DE3) cells for transformation.
steps.expected_result: Electrocompetent cells ready for transformation.

steps.title: Transform E. coli
steps.instruction: Electroporate competent E. coli with pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids and donor DNAs.
steps.expected_result: Transformed E. coli cells obtained.

steps.title: Plate Transformed Cells
steps.instruction: Plate transformed cells on LB-agar plates with appropriate antibiotics.
steps.expected_result: Colonies of transformed E. coli visible on plates.

steps.title: Perform Colony PCR
steps.instruction: Screen selected colonies using PCR to identify successful transformations.
steps.expected_result: PCR products generated for analysis.

steps.title: Design Donor DNAs
steps.instruction: Design mutagenic donor DNAs to achieve desired gene deletions.
steps.expected_result: Donor DNAs designed for gene editing.

steps.title: Synthesize Donor DNAs
steps.instruction: Order or synthesize double-stranded donor DNAs based on designs.
steps.expected_result: Donor DNAs received for use in transformations.

steps.title: Analyze PCR Products
steps.instruction: Run PCR products on an agarose gel to verify gene knockout.
steps.expected_result: Gel electrophoresis results indicating successful knockouts.

steps.title: Prepare for Sequential Transformations
steps.instruction: Prepare competent E. coli for subsequent transformations with new gDNA plasmids.
steps.expected_result: Competent cells ready for multi-gene transformations.

steps.title: Transform with Additional gDNAs
steps.instruction: Electroporate E. coli with additional pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids for multi-gene editing.
steps.expected_result: E. coli transformed with multiple gDNAs.

steps.title: Co-transform E. coli
steps.instruction: Co-transform E. coli with multiple plasmids carrying different gDNAs.
steps.expected_result: E. coli co-transformed for simultaneous gene deletions.

steps.title: Assess Transformation Efficiency
steps.instruction: Count colonies and calculate transformation efficiency for each gDNA.
steps.expected_result: Transformation efficiency data collected.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Compile and analyze data from transformations and PCR screenings.
steps.expected_result: Success rates and efficiency of gene editing determined.

steps.instruction: Administer anesthesia to the mice prior to irradiation.

steps.title: Set Up NOR Test
steps.instruction: Prepare the testing area with familiar and novel objects for the NOR test.

steps.title: Conduct NOR Test
steps.instruction: Allow mice to explore the familiar and novel objects for the designated time.

steps.instruction: Perform the DMP test by placing mice on the platform and recording their behavior.

steps.instruction: Arrange the testing area with objects for the metric distance test.

steps.instruction: Analyze processed brain samples using flow cytometry.

steps.title: Seed Cells
steps.instruction: Seed approximately one million MCF-7 cells in each of two T-75 flasks using complete medium.
steps.expected_result: Cells are seeded and ready to grow.

steps.title: Incubate Cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells at 37°C and 5% CO2 until they reach 60-70% confluency.
steps.expected_result: Cells are at the desired confluency for further treatment.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells briefly with pre-warmed DMEM or PBS.
steps.expected_result: Cells are washed and free of residual medium.

steps.title: Add Serum-Free Medium
steps.instruction: Add 10ml of pre-warmed MEGM to both flasks and incubate for 24 hours.
steps.expected_result: Cells are treated with serum-free medium.

steps.title: Prepare Control and RI-Treated Flasks
steps.instruction: Wash cells again with pre-warmed MEGM, then add 10ml of MEGM to the control flask and 10ml of MEGM with murine RNase inhibitor to the RI-treated flask.
steps.expected_result: Control and RI-treated flasks are prepared for further incubation.

steps.title: Aspirate Cell-Conditioned Medium
steps.instruction: Aspirate the cell-conditioned medium from both flasks and transfer to 15ml nuclease-free Falcon conical tubes.
steps.expected_result: Cell-conditioned medium is collected for centrifugation.

steps.title: Centrifuge Cell-Conditioned Medium
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected medium at 800×g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
steps.expected_result: Cell debris is pelleted, and supernatant is ready for further processing.

steps.title: Centrifuge Supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the supernatant at 2,000×g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
steps.expected_result: Supernatant is clarified and ready for ultracentrifugation.

steps.title: Prepare for Ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Thaw the supernatant and add murine RNase inhibitor, then centrifuge again at 2,000×g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
steps.expected_result: Sample is prepared for ultracentrifugation without precipitates.

steps.title: Prepare Ultracentrifugation Tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the clarified supernatant to ultraclear ultracentrifugation tubes and adjust the volume with ice-cold nuclease-free PBS.
steps.expected_result: Tubes are ready for ultracentrifugation.

steps.title: Run Ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in the ultracentrifuge and run at 100,000×g for 2.5 hours at 4°C.
steps.expected_result: Nonvesicular extracellular fraction is isolated.

steps.title: Collect Supernatants
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatants from the ultracentrifugation to new tubes and keep on ice.
steps.expected_result: Supernatants are collected for size exclusion chromatography.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Size Exclusion Chromatography
steps.instruction: Spin the concentrated samples at 10,000×g for 10 minutes at 4°C and transfer the supernatant to new tubes.
steps.expected_result: Samples are clarified and ready for chromatography.

steps.title: Set Up FPLC System
steps.instruction: Connect the Superdex 200 column to the FPLC system, remove ethanol, and equilibrate the column in PBS.
steps.expected_result: FPLC system is prepared for running samples.

steps.title: Inject Samples into Column
steps.instruction: Inject 500µl of the sample into the column using a 1ml syringe.
steps.expected_result: Sample is loaded into the chromatography column.

steps.title: Collect Fractions
steps.instruction: Run the chromatography at a flow rate of 1ml/min and collect fractions of 0.25ml.
steps.expected_result: Fractions are collected for analysis.

steps.title: Identify RNA Fractions
steps.instruction: Identify fractions where A260 > A280 and transfer them to new RNase-free tubes.
steps.expected_result: Selected RNA fractions are prepared for further analysis.

steps.title: Add Trizol to Fractions
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, add 750µl of Trizol LS to each collected fraction.
steps.expected_result: Fractions are ready for RNA extraction.

steps.title: Proceed with RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Follow the manufacturer's instructions for RNA extraction from the fractions.
steps.expected_result: RNA is purified from the selected fractions.

steps.title: Check RNA Concentration
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet in 9µl of RNase-free water and check concentration using a Qubit fluorimeter.
steps.expected_result: RNA concentration is measured for sequencing preparation.

steps.title: Prepare for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Use the remaining RNA sample to prepare sequencing libraries using a small RNA kit.
steps.expected_result: Sequencing libraries are ready for next-generation sequencing.

steps.expected_result: Bone marrow cells are successfully cultured and proliferating.

steps.instruction: On Day 2, remove the culture soup and add fresh complete medium with growth factors.
steps.expected_result: Cells are refreshed with new medium for continued growth.

steps.title: Harvest and Split Cells
steps.instruction: On Day 5, harvest the cells, wash them, and split them into a new culture plate with additional growth factors.
steps.expected_result: Cells are split and cultured in a new plate for further differentiation.

steps.title: Pulse with Antigen
steps.instruction: On Day 6, pulse the cells with OVA antigen for 24 hours.
steps.expected_result: Dendritic cells are loaded with the OVA antigen.

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: On Day 7, harvest the pulsed cells and wash them thoroughly to remove excess antigen.
steps.expected_result: Cells are ready for use in subsequent experiments.

steps.title: Assess Morphology
steps.instruction: Examine the morphology of the isolated iPS-DCregs under a microscope.
steps.expected_result: Morphological characteristics of iPS-DCregs are confirmed.

steps.title: Surface Marker Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform flow cytometry to analyze surface marker expression on iPS-DCregs.
steps.expected_result: Surface marker profiles are obtained to confirm identity and functionality.

steps.title: Prepare Antigen Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare fluorescein isothiocyanate-labeled ovalbumin and dextran solutions.
steps.expected_result: Antigen solutions are ready for uptake assays.

steps.title: Perform Uptake Assay
steps.instruction: Incubate iPS-DCregs with the prepared antigen solutions to assess uptake.
steps.expected_result: Data on antigen uptake ability of iPS-DCregs is collected.

steps.title: Set Up MLR
steps.instruction: Co-culture iPS-DCregs with allogeneic T cells to initiate the mixed lymphocyte reaction.
steps.expected_result: MLR is established for evaluation of antigen-presenting function.

steps.expected_result: OVA-specific MLR is established for functional assessment.

steps.expected_result: T cells are successfully transferred into the recipient mice.

steps.title: Prepare Greenhouse Conditions
steps.instruction: Set up controlled greenhouse conditions suitable for petunia plant growth.
steps.expected_result: Greenhouse environment is optimized for plant growth.

steps.title: Grow Petunia Plantlets
steps.instruction: Grow rooted petunia plantlets in the prepared greenhouse until they reach the desired developmental stage.
steps.expected_result: Rooted petunia plantlets are ready for flower collection.

steps.title: Remove Open Flowers
steps.instruction: Remove all open flowers from petunia plants one day before collection to ensure uniformity in developmental stage.
steps.expected_result: All open flowers are removed from the plants.

steps.title: Collect Open Flowers
steps.instruction: Collect completely opened flowers from the greenhouse and place them in a beaker with water.
steps.expected_result: Open flowers are collected and stored in water.

steps.title: Prepare for Protoplast Isolation
steps.instruction: Prepare necessary solutions and materials for protoplast isolation from collected flowers.
steps.expected_result: All materials are ready for the protoplast isolation process.

steps.title: Sterilize Flowers
steps.instruction: Immerse flowers in hypochlorite solution and rinse in distilled water to sterilize.
steps.expected_result: Flowers are sterilized and ready for dissection.

steps.title: Dissect Flowers
steps.instruction: Cut flowers to remove all organs except the corolla and pierce the corolla for enzyme treatment.
steps.expected_result: Flower corollas are prepared for enzyme treatment.

steps.title: Incubate in Enzyme Solution
steps.instruction: Place flower halves in enzyme solution and incubate in the dark overnight.
steps.expected_result: Flowers are incubated and ready for protoplast isolation.

steps.title: Isolate Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Collect enzyme solution containing protoplasts and wash with suspension buffer.
steps.expected_result: Protoplasts are isolated and ready for further processing.

steps.title: Extract Glycosylated Compounds
steps.instruction: Transfer vacuole solution to Eppendorf tubes and add methanol for extraction.
steps.expected_result: Glycosylated compounds are extracted from vacuoles.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for GC-MS
steps.instruction: Transfer hexane solution into glass vials for gas chromatography-mass spectrometry analysis.
steps.expected_result: Samples are prepared and stored for GC-MS analysis.

steps.title: Analyze Experimental Data
steps.instruction: Use statistical methods to analyze the collected data from experiments.
steps.expected_result: Statistical analysis is completed and results are interpreted.

steps.title: Construct Mutant Plasmids
steps.instruction: Prepare PCR reaction mixes using specified primers for the construction of mutant plasmids.
steps.expected_result: PCR reaction mixes are ready for amplification.

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Execute PCR cycling conditions to amplify the mutant plasmids.
steps.expected_result: PCR products of mutant plasmids are generated.

steps.title: Analyze PCR Products
steps.instruction: Run 10 μl of the PCR product on a 1% agarose gel for electrophoresis.
steps.expected_result: Separation of PCR products is visualized on the gel.

steps.title: Digest PCR Products
steps.instruction: Add DMT enzyme to the remaining PCR product and incubate.
steps.expected_result: PCR products are digested and ready for transformation.

steps.title: Transform Competent Cells
steps.instruction: Add DMT digestion product to competent cells, incubate on ice, heat shock, and then place on ice again.
steps.expected_result: Competent cells are transformed with mutant plasmids.

steps.title: Culture Transformed Cells
steps.instruction: Add LB medium to the transformed cells and incubate for growth.
steps.expected_result: Bacterial colonies expressing the mutant plasmids grow overnight.

steps.title: Isolate Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Pick mono-clones and culture in LB medium with ampicillin, then extract plasmid DNA.
steps.expected_result: Plasmid DNA is isolated for sequencing.

steps.title: Verify Mutations
steps.instruction: Send extracted plasmid DNA for Sanger sequencing to confirm the presence of mutations.
steps.expected_result: Sequencing results confirm successful construction of mutant plasmids.

steps.title: Extract Viral RNA
steps.instruction: Use the QIAgen Viral RNA Mini Kit to extract viral RNA from plasma samples.
steps.expected_result: Viral RNA is extracted and ready for further analysis.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the extracted RNA in nuclease-free water and aliquot into tubes.
steps.expected_result: Aliquoted RNA samples are stored for future use.

steps.title: Prepare RT-LAMP Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Combine RNA template, isothermal amplification buffer, MgSO4, dNTPs, polymerases, SYTO 9, and mixed primer sets in a PCR plate.
steps.expected_result: RT-LAMP reaction mix is prepared for amplification.

steps.title: Set RT-LAMP Cycling Conditions
steps.instruction: Perform RT-LAMP cycling at specified temperature and duration.
steps.expected_result: RT-LAMP reaction is completed and ready for detection.

steps.title: Perform Serial Dilutions
steps.instruction: Create ten-fold serial dilutions of RNA samples to assess sensitivity.
steps.expected_result: Diluted RNA samples are prepared for sensitivity testing.

steps.title: Test Limit of Detection
steps.instruction: Run RT-LAMP assay with diluted RNA samples to determine limit of detection.
steps.expected_result: Data collected to evaluate sensitivity and LOD of the assay.

steps.title: Evaluate Clinical Samples
steps.instruction: Apply the RT-LAMP assay to clinical plasma samples from dengue-suspected patients.
steps.expected_result: Results from clinical samples are obtained for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare Colorimetric RT-LAMP Mix
steps.instruction: Combine colorimetric LAMP master mix with RNA template and mixed primer sets in PCR tubes.
steps.expected_result: Colorimetric RT-LAMP reaction mix is ready for cycling.

steps.title: Perform Colorimetric RT-LAMP
steps.instruction: Run the colorimetric RT-LAMP reaction at specified temperature and duration.
steps.expected_result: Color change is observed indicating the presence of RNA.

steps.title: Obtain Ethics Approval
steps.instruction: Submit necessary documents to obtain ethical approval for the study.
steps.expected_result: Ethical approval is granted for conducting the study.

steps.title: Collect Informed Consent
steps.instruction: Gather informed consent from patients participating in the study.
steps.expected_result: Informed consent is obtained from all participants.

steps.title: Prepare Overnight Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a culture tube with 5 ml LB media and 5 µl of chloramphenicol stock solution under sterile conditions.
steps.expected_result: A saturated overnight culture of the MIG (or sfGFP) expression strain.

steps.title: Incubate Overnight Culture
steps.instruction: Incubate the overnight culture at 37°C and 250 RPM for approximately 16 hours.
steps.expected_result: A well-grown overnight culture ready for dilution.

steps.title: Dilute Overnight Culture
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 ml of the overnight culture into 50 ml LB media and add 50 µl of chloramphenicol stock solution under sterile conditions.
steps.expected_result: A diluted culture prepared for further incubation.

steps.title: Incubate Diluted Culture
steps.instruction: Incubate the diluted culture at 37°C and 250 RPM for 90 minutes.
steps.expected_result: A culture ready for IPTG induction.

steps.title: Induce Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Add 50 µM IPTG to the culture under sterile conditions.
steps.expected_result: Induction of protein expression in the culture.

steps.title: Incubate Induced Culture
steps.instruction: Incubate the culture at 37°C and 250 RPM for 60 minutes.
steps.expected_result: Protein expression is initiated in the culture.

steps.title: Prepare Electroporation Mix
steps.instruction: Mix plasmid DNA with competent E. coli cells in an electroporation cuvette.
steps.expected_result: A prepared electroporation mix ready for transformation.

steps.title: Electroporate Cells
steps.instruction: Electroporate the mix using an electroporator.
steps.expected_result: Transformed E. coli cells.

steps.title: Recover Transformed Cells
steps.instruction: Add recovery media to the electroporated cells and incubate for a specified time.
steps.expected_result: Cells are allowed to recover and express antibiotic resistance.

steps.title: Plate Transformed Cells
steps.instruction: Plate the transformed cells on antibiotic selection plates.
steps.expected_result: Selection plates with colonies of transformed E. coli.

steps.title: Amplify DNA
steps.instruction: Use PCR to amplify the DNA fragment of interest for plasmid construction.
steps.expected_result: Amplified DNA ready for assembly.

steps.title: Perform Gibson Assembly
steps.instruction: Combine the amplified DNA with vector and Gibson assembly mix to construct the plasmid.
steps.expected_result: Constructed plasmid ready for transformation.

steps.title: Prepare Kanamycin Media
steps.instruction: Prepare LB media supplemented with kanamycin for screening.
steps.expected_result: Kanamycin media ready for screening.

steps.title: Plate Constructs on Kanamycin Media
steps.instruction: Plate the KanR-DnaBi1 constructs on the prepared kanamycin media.
steps.expected_result: Plates with colonies indicating splicing-dependent resistance.

steps.title: Analyze 3D Structure
steps.instruction: Use appropriate software to analyze the 3D structure of KanR.
steps.expected_result: In silico analysis results of the KanR structure.

steps.title: Perform Spot Titer Assays
steps.instruction: Prepare dilutions of M. smegmatis and spot onto kanamycin media.
steps.expected_result: Results indicating the effectiveness of kanamycin resistance.

steps.title: Prepare MIG Reporter Assay
steps.instruction: Set up the MIG reporter assay in BL21(DE3) cells.
steps.expected_result: Assay setup ready for measuring splicing inhibition.

steps.title: Purify Protein
steps.instruction: Use affinity chromatography to purify M. smegmatis DnaBi1.
steps.expected_result: Purified protein ready for further analysis.

steps.title: Grow Crystals
steps.instruction: Set up conditions for crystal growth of zinc-bound DnaBi1.
steps.expected_result: Crystals of DnaBi1 formed.

steps.title: Process Diffraction Data
steps.instruction: Process the collected diffraction data to refine the structure.
steps.expected_result: Refined structural data of DnaBi1.

steps.title: Seed Cells
steps.instruction: Seed 150 µl of complete growth medium with fibroblasts in a 96-well imagelock plate using a multi-channel pipette.
steps.expected_result: Cells are seeded at the appropriate density to reach 95% confluence overnight.

steps.title: Counteract Evaporation
steps.instruction: Fill the outer wells of the plate with 300 µl of PBS to minimize evaporation effects.
steps.expected_result: Outer wells are filled to prevent evaporation during cell growth.

steps.title: Incubate Cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37°C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2 overnight.
steps.expected_result: Cells grow and reach approximately 95% confluence.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice with 100 µl of PBS using a multi-channel pipette.
steps.expected_result: Cells are washed to remove residual medium.

steps.title: Starve Cells
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl of FBS-free culture medium and incubate in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2 for 2 hours.
steps.expected_result: Cells are starved to deplete growth factors.

steps.title: Create Scratches
steps.instruction: Use the IncuCyte® Wound Maker to create homogenous scratches in the cell monolayer.
steps.expected_result: Scratches are created uniformly across the wells.

steps.title: Discard Medium
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the medium without disturbing the scratches using a multi-channel pipette.
steps.expected_result: Medium is removed while maintaining the integrity of the scratches.

steps.title: Add Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl of low-serum culture medium containing experimental treatments to the wells.
steps.expected_result: Treatment is applied to the scratched fibroblasts.

steps.title: Setup IncuCyte Zoom Scan
steps.instruction: Place the 96-well imagelock plate in the IncuCyte and schedule scans for the experiment.
steps.expected_result: Scanning is scheduled to monitor cell migration.

steps.title: Select Experiment for Analysis

steps.title: Create Image Collection

steps.expected_result: An image collection is prepared for analysis.

steps.title: Define Processing Parameters
steps.instruction: Define the processing parameters for the image collection, including segmentation and filtering.

steps.title: Seed Sterilization
steps.instruction: Place Arabidopsis seeds in 1.5mL tubes and wash with 70% ethanol for 1 minute.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are sterilized and ready for further processing.

steps.title: Chemical Treatment
steps.instruction: Add H2O, Tween 20, and sodium hypochlorite solution to the seeds and mix using a vortex mixer.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are treated with the chemical solution for sterilization.

steps.title: Washing Seeds
steps.instruction: Wash the seeds five times with sterilized water to remove residual chemicals.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are thoroughly rinsed and free of contaminants.

steps.title: Sowing Seeds
steps.instruction: Sow the sterilized seeds in plastic Petri dishes containing culture media.
steps.expected_result: Seeds are planted in the culture media for germination.

steps.title: Incubation for Germination
steps.instruction: Incubate the dishes at 4°C for three days followed by incubation at 23°C in darkness for five days.
steps.expected_result: Seedlings are etiolated and ready for light exposure.

steps.title: Light Cycle Growth
steps.instruction: Grow the seedlings under a 10h light/14h dark cycle at 23°C for five days.
steps.expected_result: Cotyledons of seedlings become green, indicating healthy growth.

steps.title: Hypocotyl Cutting
steps.instruction: Cut the hypocotyls of the seedlings with a razor blade to initiate xylem exudate collection.
steps.expected_result: Xylem exudates begin to form droplets on the cut surface.

steps.title: Collection of Exudates
steps.instruction: Wipe the first droplets and collect subsequent droplets with a micropipette at intervals.
steps.expected_result: Xylem exudates are collected for analysis.

steps.title: Storage of Exudates
steps.instruction: Store the collected xylem exudates at -80°C until further analysis.
steps.expected_result: Exudates are preserved for peptide identification.

steps.title: Preparation of Plant Samples
steps.instruction: Treat plants with the photosynthesis inhibitor DCMU or place them in prolonged darkness.
steps.expected_result: Plants are prepared for expression analysis of CLE2.

steps.title: RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from treated plant samples using an appropriate RNA extraction kit.
steps.expected_result: High-quality RNA is obtained for expression analysis.

steps.title: cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from the extracted RNA using reverse transcription.
steps.expected_result: cDNA is generated for quantitative analysis.

steps.title: Quantitative PCR
steps.instruction: Perform quantitative PCR to analyze the expression levels of CLE2.
steps.expected_result: Expression levels of CLE2 are quantified.

steps.title: Design CRISPR Constructs
steps.instruction: Design CRISPR/Cas9 constructs targeting CLE2 and CLE3 genes.
steps.expected_result: CRISPR constructs are ready for transformation.

steps.title: Transformation of Plant Cells
steps.instruction: Transform Arabidopsis plant cells with the designed CRISPR constructs.
steps.expected_result: Transformed plant cells are generated for mutant line selection.

steps.title: Selection of Mutant Lines
steps.instruction: Select and propagate cle2cle3 double mutants and cle1-7 septuple mutants.
steps.expected_result: Mutant lines are established for functional analysis.

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Collect root and leaf samples from cle2, cle3, cle2cle3, and cle1-7 mutants.
steps.expected_result: Samples are ready for sugar and starch content analysis.

steps.title: Sugar and Starch Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze sugar and starch contents in the collected samples using appropriate assays.
steps.expected_result: Quantitative data on sugar and starch contents are obtained.

steps.title: Construct Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare constructs for gain-of-function analysis using the CoYMV promoter for CLE2.
steps.expected_result: Gain-of-function constructs are ready for transformation.

steps.title: Transformation of Plants
steps.instruction: Transform Arabidopsis plants with the gain-of-function constructs.
steps.expected_result: Transformed plants expressing CLE2 are generated.

steps.title: Analysis of Sucrose Levels
steps.instruction: Measure sucrose levels in the transformed plants after 24 hours.
steps.expected_result: Data on sucrose levels in response to ectopic expression of CLE2 is obtained.

steps.title: Peptide Application
steps.instruction: Apply synthetic CLE2 peptide to rosette leaves of Arabidopsis.
steps.expected_result: Peptide is successfully applied to the plant leaves.

steps.title: Measurement of Sugar and Starch Contents
steps.instruction: Measure the resulting sugar and starch contents in the leaves after 24 hours.
steps.expected_result: Data on sugar and starch contents post-application is collected.

steps.title: Preparation for Grafting
steps.instruction: Prepare cle1-7 and WT plants for grafting by cutting stems appropriately.
steps.expected_result: Plants are ready for grafting procedure.

steps.title: Perform Grafting
steps.instruction: Graft cle1-7 and WT plants together and secure the grafts.
steps.expected_result: Grafted plants are established for further analysis.

steps.title: Sample Collection
steps.instruction: Collect leaf and root samples from various mutants for expression analysis.
steps.expected_result: Samples are prepared for quantitative expression analysis.

steps.title: Gene Expression Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the expression levels of sucrose-related genes in the collected samples.
steps.expected_result: Quantitative data on gene expression levels is obtained.

steps.title: Euthanize Pregnant Mice
steps.instruction: Euthanize the pregnant mice using CO2 overdose.
steps.expected_result: Pregnant mice are euthanized and ready for dissection.

steps.title: Isolate Embryos
steps.instruction: Remove the uterus and free individual fetuses, placing them in sterile dissection medium on ice.
steps.expected_result: Embryos are isolated and kept on ice to prevent degradation.

steps.title: Prepare Brain Tissue
steps.instruction: Decapitate embryos, remove skin and skull, and place the brains in cold dissection medium.
steps.expected_result: Brains are prepared and stored in dissection medium.

steps.title: Dissect Brain Regions
steps.instruction: Under a stereomicroscope, remove olfactory bulbs, cerebellum, and midbrain, then dissect out the hippocampus and cortex.
steps.expected_result: Hippocampus and cortex are isolated from the brain.

steps.title: Wash and Prepare Tissues
steps.instruction: Wash the isolated tissues with fresh dissection medium and then add disruption medium.
steps.expected_result: Tissues are washed and treated with disruption medium.

steps.title: Count Neuronal Cells
steps.instruction: Count the neuronal cells using a Bürker Counting chamber after resuspending in neuronal complete medium.
steps.expected_result: Neuronal cell count is obtained for further use.

steps.title: Store Neuronal Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in Neurostore medium and aliquot into cryovials for storage.
steps.expected_result: Neuronal cells are stored in cryovials at -80°C or in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Transduce Neurons
steps.instruction: Add GFP-expressing lentivirus to the neuronal cultures at the specified multiplicity of infection.
steps.expected_result: Neurons are transduced with the lentivirus for labeling.

steps.title: Treat Neurons
steps.instruction: Add FGFb and EGF to the neuronal cultures for a short duration.
steps.expected_result: Neurons are treated to stimulate growth and signaling pathways.

steps.title: Perform MTT Assay
steps.instruction: Add MTT solution to neuronal cultures and measure absorbance after incubation.
steps.expected_result: Absorbance readings are obtained to assess cell viability.

steps.title: Extract Proteins
steps.instruction: Lysis of neurons is performed to extract proteins for quantification.
steps.expected_result: Proteins are extracted and ready for quantification.

steps.title: Conduct Western Blotting
steps.instruction: Separate proteins by SDS-PAGE, transfer to a membrane, and probe with specific antibodies.
steps.expected_result: Target proteins are detected on the membrane.

steps.title: Fix and Stain Neurons
steps.instruction: Fix neuronal cultures and stain with antibodies to visualize specific proteins.
steps.expected_result: Neurons are stained and ready for imaging.

steps.title: Perform Electrophysiological Recordings
steps.instruction: Conduct whole-cell patch clamp recordings to assess neuronal electrical activity.
steps.expected_result: Electrophysiological data is collected from neurons.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Log and analyze data using statistical software to evaluate significance and trends.
steps.expected_result: Data analysis is completed and results are interpreted.
